The study was conducted to evaluate agronomic characteristics and genetic diversity using correlation analysis, principal component analysis, and cluster analysis on 20 agronomic traits of 16 tropical sweet corn inbred lines (NGO1-NGO16) and 4 temperate lines (NGO17-NGO20) at the S4 selfed generation (developed from imported varieties originating from Thailand, China, Japan, and the United States), with three control inbred lines: SW1 (sweet, yellow), D181 (sweet, white), and UV10 (sweet, purple). The experiment was arranged in a completely randomized block design with three replications in Hanoi during the 2022 fall-winter season, with 20 agronomic traits divided into four groups: five growth traits, seven morphological traits, seven yield traits, and one quality trait. Correlation analysis results showed that individual yield was positively correlated at p<0.01 with kernels per row (0.61), rows per ear (0.57), and positively correlated at p<0.05 with ear diameter (0.47) and ear length (0.45). The 20 traits were reduced to three principal components, accounting for 66.8% of phenotypic variation. Among these, growth period, plant height, ear height, leaf angle, rows per ear, kernels per row, 1000-kernel weight, individual yield, and total soluble solids content could be used to evaluate differences among sweet corn lines. Cluster analysis based on principal components of the 20 agronomic traits classified the 20 sweet corn lines into three main groups. The study provides useful information on genetic diversity based on phenotypic traits and enriches valuable sweet corn germplasm for high-quality food corn breeding programs in Vietnam.

In the context of analyzing and designing software to check weld quality using image processing technology and segmentation deep learning, the principle of separation of concerns, as implemented by the MVVM (Model-View-ViewModel) architectural pattern, becomes especially valuable. MVVM’s approach of isolating the business logic and data (handled within the Model and ViewModel) from the user interface (managed by the View) enables developers to streamline the integration of complex weld quality assessment algorithms, including convolutional neural networks (CNNs) designed for image segmentation, without entangling them with presentation layer code. This modularity not only facilitates independent development and testing of core functionalities—such as preprocessing image data, applying segmentation models, and interpreting output for weld defect classification—but also simplifies future upgrades, such as retraining models on new datasets or enhancing the UI to support additional visualization tools for weld inspection results. Moreover, the clear separation enforced by MVVM allows for more robust unit testing of the data processing and inference logic, which is crucial in high-stakes applications like automated weld quality assurance where precision and reliability are paramount. By adhering to these principles, the software architecture not only supports current requirements but also scales with advances in deep learning techniques and evolving user needs, ensuring the system remains maintainable and adaptable over time.

In addition to the components already described, the Ethereum blockchain environment also incorporates the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM), which acts as a decentralized computational engine responsible for executing smart contracts and maintaining the deterministic state of the blockchain. The EVM enables developers to deploy and run smart contracts written in Solidity or other compatible languages, ensuring that code execution is consistent across all nodes regardless of platform or hardware differences. The environment further relies on consensus algorithms such as Proof of Stake (PoS) or, previously, Proof of Work (PoW), to validate and confirm transactions, thus preventing double-spending and ensuring the integrity of the distributed ledger. Smart contracts, once deployed, are immutable and self-executing based on predefined rules, allowing for trustless interactions between parties. The Ethereum environment also includes various application programming interfaces (APIs) and developer tools, such as web3.js and Remix IDE, which facilitate the development, testing, and deployment of decentralized applications (dApps). To enhance security, cryptographic techniques such as public-private key pairs and digital signatures are used not only to safeguard user accounts but also to authenticate and authorize transactions on the network. Finally, the peer-to-peer network protocol ensures that all participating nodes synchronize blockchain data efficiently, while mechanisms such as gas fees regulate computational resource usage and discourage malicious activities like infinite loops or denial-of-service attacks.

Generating animations from natural language sentences has applications in various domains, including movie script visualization, virtual human animation, and robot motion planning. These sentences can describe a range of actions, specify the speed and direction of those actions, and potentially indicate a target destination. The primary modeling challenge in this language-to-pose task lies in effectively mapping linguistic concepts to motion animations. In this paper, we address this multimodal challenge by introducing a neural architecture called Joint Language to Pose (JL2P), which learns a joint embedding of language and pose. This joint embedding space is trained end-to-end using a curriculum learning approach that prioritizes shorter and simpler sequences before progressing to longer and more complex ones. We evaluate our model using a publicly available corpus of 3D pose data paired with human-annotated sentences. Both objective metrics and human judgment evaluations demonstrate that our proposed approach generates more accurate animations and is considered visually more representative by humans compared to other data-driven methods.

Most websites may easily be configured with Laravel’s strong security capabilities to improve security and defend against hackers and cybercriminals. Technically speaking, Laravel never stores any passwords in the database since it employs the Bcrypt hashing method. When compared to other PHP frameworks, Laravel also includes excellent user authentication and simple-to-create limited access capabilities. This safeguards the data of both you and your clients. Specifically, Laravel’s built-in authentication system supports multiple user types and roles, enabling fine-grained access control which is essential in a SaaS-based search engine environment where different levels of user permissions are required. Moreover, Laravel’s active community and regular security updates contribute to a proactive defense strategy, allowing the SaaS application to adapt to emerging security threats effectively. This comprehensive security framework makes Laravel an ideal choice for developing a secure, reliable, and scalable search engine tailored for e-commerce websites.

A RESTful API transmits a representation of the resource’s state to the requester or endpoint when a client request is made through it. One of various forms, including JSON (Javascript Object Notation), HTML, XLT, Python, PHP, or plain text, is used to send this information or representation through HTTP. Despite its name, JSON is the most widely used file format because it can be read by both people and machines and is language-independent. JSON's popularity in SaaS-based search engines for e-commerce platforms is also attributed to its lightweight structure, which allows for faster data interchange and easier integration with a wide range of frontend frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js, thereby enhancing the responsiveness and scalability of applications. Furthermore, RESTful APIs using JSON facilitate seamless communication between microservices and third-party applications, enabling features like product search, filtering, and recommendation systems to be implemented efficiently. Security mechanisms such as authentication tokens or API keys can also be transmitted securely within the JSON payload, ensuring that the API endpoints are protected from unauthorized access, which is crucial in the context of handling sensitive e-commerce data. In addition, JSON's hierarchical data representation aligns well with the nested nature of product catalogs and user profiles in e-commerce, making it ideal for complex queries and aggregations required by modern search engines.

However, relying solely on accuracy can be misleading, especially in cases where the dataset is imbalanced. For instance, in a scenario where the majority class is significantly larger than the minority class, a model might achieve high accuracy by predominantly predicting the majority class, thus failing to capture the nuances of the minority class. This shortcoming necessitates the use of additional metrics such as precision, recall, and the F1-score. Precision, defined as the ratio of true positive predictions to the total positive predictions (TP / (TP + FP)), provides insight into the model’s ability to correctly identify positive instances without misclassifying negative instances as positive. Recall, on the other hand, is the ratio of correctly predicted positive observations to all actual positives (TP / (TP + FN)), highlighting the model's capability to detect all relevant instances. The F1-score, which is the harmonic mean of precision and recall (2 * (Precision * Recall) / (Precision + Recall)), serves as a balanced measure that accounts for both false positives and false negatives, especially useful in contexts where the cost of false negatives and false positives are similar. These metrics, when used in conjunction, offer a more comprehensive understanding of model performance, particularly in datasets with class imbalance, thereby facilitating more informed decision-making and model selection.

The Northern Midlands and Mountainous Region is an area of particular significance in terms of politics, economy, society, national defense, and security, serving as the "protective rampart" and northern gateway of the country, and plays a decisive role regarding energy resources, water sources, and the ecological environment of the entire Northern region. Although this region possesses substantial economic development potential, it is characterized by complex, rugged, and fragmented terrain, currently facing numerous difficulties, including slow economic growth and a lack of and weak infrastructure, especially in transportation, irrigation, and urban-rural development, while frequently being affected by natural disasters. In recent years, the situation of natural disasters has become increasingly complicated, especially with frequent occurrences of landslides, rockfalls, floods, and flash floods, causing serious losses in human lives, property, and the ecological environment. This paper synthesizes and shares information related to the region, natural disasters, and the impacts of climate change, while also proposing several technical preparation solutions to help mitigate the impacts on the construction of residential areas in this region.

Recall là tỉ lệ các thuật ngữ mà người chú thích đánh giá là nút cha hợp lý và cũng được mô hình nhận diện đúng trên tổng số thuật ngữ mà người chú thích lựa chọn, phản ánh khả năng bao phủ các mối quan hệ cha-con đúng đắn của hệ thống. Giá trị F1 được xác định là trung bình điều hòa của Precision và Recall, nhằm cân bằng giữa độ chính xác và khả năng bao phủ, cung cấp một chỉ số tổng hợp để đánh giá hiệu quả của phương pháp xác định quan hệ phân cấp giữa các nút trong cấu trúc taxonomy. Quy trình đánh giá này giúp kiểm chứng được mức độ tin cậy cũng như tính thực tiễn trong việc áp dụng mô hình vào các bộ dữ liệu có số lượng thuật ngữ lớn, vốn là đặc trưng của các ontology chuyên ngành hoặc các hệ thống phân loại tự động. Để đảm bảo kết quả đánh giá khách quan, các mẫu thuật ngữ con được lựa chọn ngẫu nhiên, đồng thời quá trình chú thích được thực hiện bởi nhiều người chú thích độc lập nhằm giảm thiểu sai lệch chủ quan. Các thuật ngữ được trình bày dưới dạng danh sách các từ khóa tiêu biểu, giúp người chú thích dễ dàng so sánh và xác định mối liên hệ chủ đề. Sau khi hoàn thành giai đoạn đánh giá, số liệu thu thập được phân tích thống kê để xác định những điểm mạnh, hạn chế của phương pháp cũng như so sánh với các phương pháp xây dựng taxonomy truyền thống hoặc các mô hình học sâu hiện đại. Ngoài ra, việc phân tích các trường hợp mô hình và người chú thích bất đồng trong lựa chọn nút cha còn cung cấp thông tin quan trọng về những trường hợp mơ hồ, đa nghĩa hoặc các khía cạnh mà mô hình cần được cải thiện. Trong quá trình thực nghiệm, các thông số như số lượng lớp trong taxonomy, số lượng thuật ngữ ở mỗi cấp, và độ đa dạng chủ đề đều được kiểm soát nhằm đảm bảo tính đại diện và khả năng tổng quát hóa của kết quả. Đối với các bộ dữ liệu lớn, việc đánh giá theo phương pháp lấy mẫu điểm đánh giá như trên không chỉ giúp tiết kiệm nguồn lực mà còn duy trì được độ chính xác cần thiết, tránh được những sai lệch có thể xảy ra khi đánh giá thủ công toàn bộ hệ thống. Sau khi tính toán các chỉ số Precision, Recall và F1 cho từng cặp mức liền kề trong taxonomy, kết quả được tổng hợp thành bảng số liệu, qua đó rút ra nhận xét về hiệu quả tổng thể của phương pháp đề xuất. Cuối cùng, các kết luận rút ra từ quá trình đánh giá sẽ được sử dụng để điều chỉnh hoặc cải tiến thuật toán phân loại, đồng thời củng cố luận điểm về tính ứng dụng thực tiễn của mô hình trong các bài toán xử lý ngôn ngữ tự nhiên, xây dựng hệ thống gợi ý, tìm kiếm thông tin hoặc tổ chức tri thức tự động.

The Warehouse Management application builds a clear business process, fully meeting the functions of managing goods information, storage information, and the situation of import-export inventory of goods. However, while it effectively handles data related to inventory records and transactional details, the application has not focused much on controlling the actual situation of goods in the warehouse. This gap highlights the need for integrating real-time tracking technologies such as RFID (Radio-Frequency Identification) to enhance inventory rotation and accuracy in logistics warehouses. RFID technology enables automated identification and data capture by using tags attached to items, which can be read remotely without line-of-sight, thus significantly improving the monitoring of goods' physical presence and movement within the warehouse. Implementing RFID systems can reduce human errors, minimize stock discrepancies, and optimize inventory turnover rates by providing timely updates on stock levels and locations. Furthermore, automated inventory processes facilitated by RFID can streamline warehouse operations, improve labor efficiency, and support just-in-time inventory management strategies. Therefore, incorporating RFID automation into warehouse management systems addresses the current limitations of the application by controlling the actual situation of goods in real-time, fostering more accurate inventory rotation, and enhancing overall supply chain efficiency.

We present a scalable technique for upper bounding the Lipschitz constant of generative models. We establish a connection between this constant and the maximal norm over the set of attainable vector-Jacobian products for a given generative model. To approximate this set, we employ layerwise convex approximations using zonotopes. Our approach generalizes and improves upon previous work utilizing zonotope transformers, and extends Lipschitz estimation to neural networks with high-dimensional outputs. This method yields efficient and tight bounds for small networks, and is scalable to generative models implemented with VAE and DCGAN architectures.

In neural combinatorial optimization (CO), reinforcement learning (RL) can transform a deep neural network into a rapid, effective heuristic solver for NP-hard problems. This method holds significant potential for practical applications as it facilitates near-optimal solutions without requiring experts with extensive domain knowledge. We introduce Policy Optimization with Multiple Optima (POMO), an end-to-end approach for constructing such heuristic solvers. POMO is applicable to a broad spectrum of CO problems and is specifically designed to leverage the symmetries inherent in CO solutions. It employs a modified REINFORCE algorithm that directs diverse rollouts towards all optimal solutions. Empirically, POMO's low-variance baseline accelerates and stabilizes RL training, offering greater resistance to local minima than previous methods. Additionally, we present a new augmentation-based inference method that complements POMO effectively. We demonstrate POMO's efficacy by solving three well-known NP-hard problems: traveling salesman (TSP), capacitated vehicle routing (CVRP), and 0-1 knapsack (KP). For each, our POMO-based solver significantly outperforms all recent learned heuristics. Notably, we achieve an optimality gap of 0.14% with TSP100 while reducing inference time by over an order of magnitude.

Building upon the foundational work of H. Zhang et al. (2022), recent studies have sought to further enhance continual relation extraction by addressing the challenges associated with feature redundancy and catastrophic forgetting. One promising approach involves integrating feature decorrelation techniques, which aim to minimize the overlap between learned representations of different relations, thereby improving the model's ability to generalize and retain knowledge over time. This strategy not only complements the prompt-based prototypical framework proposed by Zhang et al. but also introduces mechanisms to preserve the discriminative features essential for distinguishing complex relational patterns. Experimental results on benchmark datasets demonstrate that incorporating feature decorrelation leads to significant improvements in both accuracy and robustness, suggesting a fruitful direction for future research in continual learning paradigms within natural language processing.

In the context of federated learning, the algorithm initiates with the global model parameters w(0), followed by iterative rounds where, at each round t, a random subset of K nodes (clients) is selected to perform local computations as per the procedural steps outlined in the original excerpt. Specifically, for every selected node i∈Knodes, local model updates are carried out in parallel using the function LocalUpdate(i, w(t−1)), where the local data on node i is used to adjust the model parameters based on the most recent global state w(t−1). Upon completion of the local updates, the individual models wi(t) from participating nodes are aggregated to form the updated global model w(t), commonly via weighted averaging as indicated by the notation PK. This framework underpins the Federated Impurity Weighting method, where impurity-based metrics may be incorporated into the aggregation process to improve the convergence rate and generalization of federated models, especially in heterogeneous data environments. The explicit iteration and aggregation steps support scalable and privacy-preserving distributed training, which is the foundation for the subsequent theoretical analysis and experimental results that demonstrate the efficacy of impurity weighting in federated learning scenarios.

Original Essay: Consensus Layer : This layer ensures a consistent state of the blockchain. At the time of data recording, Ethereum will take about 12 - 14 seconds to create a block, which means that many miners can create a valid block at the same time, resulting in Stale blocks (a stale block is a valid block, however, this block must not be on the longest chain of the blockchain). Ethereum uses many consensus algorithms to choose the branch with the highest cumulative difficulty. Previously, consensus algorithms using PoW took a lot of energy and time, so Ethereum is planning to replace PoW with PoS.

In the context of blockchain technology, the consensus layer plays a critical role in maintaining the integrity and uniformity of the data across the network. Given the decentralized nature of Ethereum, the speed at which blocks are created is a crucial factor, currently taking approximately 12 to 14 seconds per block. This relatively short block time allows for the possibility of multiple miners successfully mining a block simultaneously, which leads to the generation of stale blocks. These stale blocks, although valid, do not get added to the longest chain, as they are not part of the main blockchain, which is determined by the branch with the highest cumulative difficulty. Ethereum's consensus algorithms are designed to select this primary branch, effectively discarding stale blocks to ensure the blockchain remains coherent and secure. Historically, Ethereum relied on Proof of Work (PoW) consensus algorithms, which are known for their high energy consumption and extended processing times. These drawbacks have prompted Ethereum to transition towards Proof of Stake (PoS), which promises a more efficient and environmentally friendly approach by reducing the computational power required for block validation. This shift not only aims to enhance the scalability and sustainability of the Ethereum network but also aligns with broader industry trends towards more sustainable blockchain practices. As Ethereum continues to evolve, the consensus layer remains a pivotal component in guaranteeing the reliability and functionality of the blockchain, balancing the need for security with the demand for efficiency and reduced environmental impact.

Lá cây thạch vĩ (Pyrrosia lingua (Thunb.) Farwell) là dược liệu có tác dụng lợi tiểu, tiêu viêm, hỗ trợ điều trị sỏi thận, viêm bàng quang, viêm tiết niệu và niệu đạo. Do Việt Nam còn thiếu các nghiên cứu về loài này, đề tài tiến hành khảo sát một số hoạt tính sinh học in vitro gồm kháng oxy hóa, kháng khuẩn và kháng nấm từ dịch chiết toàn phần lá cây thạch vĩ. Lá thạch vĩ được chiết bằng phương pháp ngấm kiệt với ethanol 70% (tỷ lệ nguyên liệu:dung môi 1:10 (g/ml), 60 phút, 50ºC) để thu cao chiết, sau đó pha loãng thành dịch chiết toàn phần. Dịch chiết này được đánh giá hoạt tính kháng oxy hóa (theo khả năng khử gốc tự do 2,2-diphenyl-1-picrylhydrazyl) và khả năng kháng khuẩn, kháng nấm (bằng phương pháp đặt đĩa kháng sinh). Dịch chiết lá thạch vĩ thể hiện khả năng kháng oxy hóa cao (IC50 = 76,96 mg/ml), tuy thấp hơn vitamin C (IC50 = 51,86 mg/ml). Dịch chiết ức chế các chủng vi khuẩn Staphylococcus aureus, Staphylococcus epidermidis, Streptococcus pneumoniae ở nhiều nồng độ (60–100 mg/ml), trong đó hoạt tính tăng theo nồng độ dịch chiết. Tuy nhiên, dịch chiết không có tác dụng lên vi khuẩn Escherichia coli, Klebsiella pneumoniae, Pseudomonas aeruginosa và vi nấm Candida albican ở mọi nồng độ khảo sát. Nghiên cứu này đã xác định một số hoạt tính sinh học in vitro của dịch chiết lá cây thạch vĩ, góp phần bổ sung tiềm năng ứng dụng và là cơ sở cho các nghiên cứu chuyên sâu hơn về hoạt tính sinh học của loài này.

As machine learning models and the data they process become more intricate, the need for explainability continues to rise. High-dimensional input features present particular difficulties: while model-agnostic explainability methods are often computationally prohibitive, faster algorithms generally lack meaningful interpretations for end users. This study proposes a framework aimed at achieving human-understandable explanations for models handling high-dimensional data, structured around two main components. The first module employs a semantically rich latent representation to both decrease data dimensionality and maintain interpretability for humans; these latent features may be obtained through explicit methods like disentangled representations, implicit techniques such as image-to-image translation, or any user-defined computable metrics. The second module modifies the Shapley-based model-agnostic explainability approach so that it functions over these latent features. The resulting explanations are interpretable, theoretically robust, and computationally feasible. Our method is evaluated on synthetic datasets and validated across diverse image-classification tasks, demonstrating its practical utility.

By using caching, the server could respond instantly without querying the database or executing slow procedures. Using caching also means that we have to clear and update the cache properly to ensure the integration of data. Effective cache management is critical in maintaining data consistency and system reliability, especially in a dynamic environment like an English teaching and learning software system where content and user interactions frequently change. Improper cache invalidation can lead to stale data being served to users, which may negatively affect the learning experience by providing outdated or incorrect information. Therefore, implementing robust cache update mechanisms, such as time-to-live (TTL) settings, event-driven cache invalidation, or versioning strategies, becomes essential. Additionally, the choice of caching technology—whether in-memory caches like Redis or Memcached, or distributed caches integrated with the application—must align with the system's scalability and performance requirements. Balancing cache freshness with response speed is a pivotal design consideration, ensuring that the system remains both responsive and accurate in delivering educational content and tracking learner progress. Consequently, the caching strategy must be integrated seamlessly with the underlying database and application logic to maintain data integrity and provide a smooth user experience.

In the context of developing a secure e-commerce luxury clothes website, managing user login information with stringent validation criteria is paramount to ensuring data integrity and protecting user privacy. The login information includes several mandatory fields such as email, password, confirm password, first name, family name, date of birth, phone number, address, sex, and an image upload, with each field adhering to specific validation rules. For instance, the email must be a valid structured address, passwords are required to be unsigned, contain no spaces, have a minimum of eight characters, and include a combination of letters, numbers, uppercase characters, and at least one special character (e.g., !, @). Moreover, the confirm password field ensures consistency by requiring the exact replication of the entered password. Stringent restrictions on image uploads specify acceptable file types (jpeg, png, jpg, or webp) and size limitations (below 1024*1024 pixels or less than 1MB), further contributing to the robustness of the system. To facilitate secure account management, administrative capabilities include a feature to delete user accounts, which is triggered by the admin selecting the delete option after logging into the system. The deletion process incorporates a warning window with suggestions to disable the account before confirming the deletion, thereby preventing accidental loss of data. When the admin confirms the deletion, the system removes the account information from the database and displays a success message; if the admin cancels, the system communicates the cancellation to the user. Importantly, the system employs bcrypt password hashing, a process that converts passwords into alphanumeric sequences using specialized algorithms, enhancing security by ensuring that even if attackers breach the database, the actual passwords remain obfuscated and protected from unauthorized access. This comprehensive approach to user information management and security mechanisms exemplifies best practices in safeguarding sensitive data within e-commerce platforms.

Phương pháp thí nghiệm được tiến hành trên tập dữ liệu chuẩn hóa đã qua quá trình tiền xử lý như đã trình bày ở các chương trước, bao gồm các bước xoay chỉnh tài liệu, loại bỏ nhiễu và căn chỉnh góc nhìn nhằm đảm bảo dữ liệu đầu vào phù hợp cho cả mô hình cơ sở và mô hình đề xuất. Các chỉ số đánh giá được sử dụng bao gồm độ chính xác (accuracy), độ nhạy (recall), độ đặc hiệu (specificity) và F1-score, đây là các chỉ số thường dùng để đánh giá hiệu quả của các mô hình phân loại, đặc biệt trong các bài toán có phân bố dữ liệu không cân bằng. Quá trình huấn luyện được thực hiện với các siêu tham số tối ưu hóa như learning rate, batch size, số epoch, và các giá trị này được lựa chọn dựa trên quá trình thử nghiệm nhằm đạt được kết quả tốt nhất cho cả hai mô hình. Ở giai đoạn đầu, mô hình cơ sở chỉ sử dụng đặc trưng văn bản thuần túy để huấn luyện, không tích hợp thông tin về không gian hay tương quan giữa các hộp văn bản, dẫn đến kết quả nhận diện các thực thể trong tài liệu bị hạn chế về mặt ngữ cảnh và vị trí. Ngược lại, mô hình đề xuất áp dụng BERT để lấy đặc trưng ngữ nghĩa đồng thời kết hợp với thông tin không gian thông qua các đặc trưng tọa độ, sau đó xây dựng biểu diễn đồ thị giữa các hộp văn bản nhằm tận dụng tối đa mối quan hệ giữa các thực thể trong tài liệu. Đặc biệt, việc sử dụng hàm mất mát tiêu điểm đã chứng minh hiệu quả rõ rệt khi mô hình cần học các lớp dữ liệu hiếm gặp, giúp tăng cường khả năng phân biệt của mô hình đối với các trường hợp ít xuất hiện mà mô hình cơ sở thường bỏ sót. Kết quả thực nghiệm cho thấy mô hình đề xuất vượt trội hơn hẳn so với mô hình cơ sở ở tất cả các chỉ số đánh giá, trong đó độ chính xác và F1-score tăng đáng kể, đặc biệt ở các lớp dữ liệu có tần suất xuất hiện thấp. Hình A minh họa biểu đồ so sánh độ chính xác giữa hai mô hình trên tập kiểm thử, với mô hình đề xuất đạt 92.3% so với 87.6% của mô hình cơ sở. Tương tự, Hình B thể hiện sự cải thiện về F1-score ở từng lớp nhãn, cho thấy sự ổn định cao hơn của mô hình đề xuất khi xử lý các nhãn ít xuất hiện. Ngoài ra, thời gian hội tụ của mô hình đề xuất cũng giảm xuống đáng kể nhờ áp dụng hàm mất mát tiêu điểm, như minh họa ở Hình C, với số epoch cần thiết để đạt độ chính xác tối ưu giảm từ 35 xuống còn 22. Kết quả này khẳng định hiệu quả của việc tích hợp các đặc trưng không gian và sử dụng hàm mất mát tiêu điểm trong mô hình mạng nơron đồ thị đề xuất. Trong phần tiếp theo, em sẽ phân tích chi tiết hơn về các trường hợp đặc biệt mà mô hình đề xuất nhận diện thành công nhưng mô hình cơ sở không xử lý được, đồng thời thảo luận về các giới hạn cũng như hướng phát triển tiếp theo của nghiên cứu.

Lượng máu mất trong phẫu thuật có sự khác biệt đáng kể tùy thuộc vào loại hình can thiệp, vị trí tổn thương và thời gian phẫu thuật. Các phẫu thuật phức tạp như chỉnh hình xương chậu hoặc cột sống thường liên quan đến mất máu nhiều hơn so với các phẫu thuật ở chi trên hoặc chi dưới đơn giản. Bên cạnh đó, yếu tố kỹ thuật phẫu thuật và kinh nghiệm của phẫu thuật viên cũng đóng vai trò quan trọng trong việc kiểm soát mất máu. Việc đánh giá chính xác lượng máu mất trong quá trình phẫu thuật giúp bác sĩ gây mê hồi sức có kế hoạch truyền máu và quản lý tình trạng huyết động hiệu quả, từ đó giảm thiểu nguy cơ biến chứng và cải thiện kết quả điều trị cho bệnh nhân. Ngoài ra, nghiên cứu cũng đề xuất áp dụng các biện pháp kiểm soát mất máu tích cực như sử dụng thuốc cầm máu, kỹ thuật phẫu thuật ít xâm lấn và theo dõi sát các chỉ số sinh tồn trong suốt quá trình phẫu thuật nhằm tối ưu hóa chăm sóc bệnh nhân chỉnh hình.

The Pickle library, which enables the saving and loading of Python objects, is commonly utilized during the training process and the integration of machine learning models into applications. By allowing for the serialization and deserialization of diverse Python objects such as arrays, lists, and dictionaries, Pickle supports the efficient storage and retrieval of these objects. This functionality allows trained models to be easily preserved and reused, thus supporting smooth integration across multiple computing environments and microservices.

Có nhiều cách để tạo lỗ trong văn bản bằng cách thay đổi các ký tự, bao gồm tạo lỗ bằng teencode, đổi chỗ các ký tự, thay thế ngẫu nhiên bằng các ký tự lân cận, loại bỏ ký tự, thêm một ký tự bất kì vào, tạo lỗ VNI (ví dụ: ă > a8), thay thế bằng các từ tương đồng dễ nhầm lẫn, và tạo các cặp từ dễ nhầm lẫn do vùng miền hay do cách phát âm (ví dụ: se > sẻ).

Phương pháp so sánh hai khung hình liên tiếp nhằm phát hiện chuyển động được thực hiện bằng cách chuyển đổi các khung hình sang dạng grayscale để giảm thiểu nhiễu và đơn giản hóa quá trình xử lý. Sau đó, thuật toán tính hiệu giá trị tuyệt đối giữa hai khung hình này để tạo ra một ảnh khác biệt, thể hiện sự thay đổi tại từng điểm ảnh. Tiếp theo, ảnh khác biệt sẽ được làm mờ bằng Gaussian Blur để loại bỏ các chi tiết nhỏ không quan trọng, giúp giảm các phát hiện sai do nhiễu hình ảnh. Quá trình tiếp theo là áp dụng ngưỡng (threshold) để biến ảnh khác biệt thành ảnh nhị phân, trong đó các điểm ảnh có sự thay đổi lớn hơn ngưỡng sẽ được đánh dấu là vị trí có chuyển động. Cuối cùng, sử dụng các phép toán hình thái học như đóng (closing) để khắc phục các lỗ nhỏ trong vùng chuyển động, từ đó dễ dàng xác định được các vùng có chuyển động rõ ràng trong khung hình. Phương pháp này đơn giản, hiệu quả với các trường hợp môi trường ổn định và ít thay đổi ánh sáng, đồng thời có thể được cải tiến bằng cách kết hợp với các kỹ thuật nâng cao khác như lọc đối tượng nhỏ hoặc theo dõi đối tượng trên nhiều khung hình để tăng độ chính xác cho hệ thống phát hiện chuyển động.

Code First API sẽ tạo ra cơ sở dữ liệu dựa trên các lớp thực thể và lớp cấu hình của bạn.

Optical flow refers to the apparent motion of objects between consecutive frames in a sequence, resulting from the relative movement between the object and the camera. Based on the pixels being processed, there are two main approaches: sparse optical flow and dense optical flow.

Redux là một công cụ quản lý trạng thái mạnh mẽ và hiệu quả được áp dụng rộng rãi trong việc phát triển các ứng dụng JavaScript, đặc biệt là khi kết hợp với thư viện React. Mục tiêu chính của Redux là cung cấp một cách tiếp cận đơn giản và có cấu trúc rõ ràng để quản lý trạng thái của ứng dụng. Một trong những ưu điểm nổi bật của Redux là khả năng duy trì một trạng thái ứng dụng toàn cục nhất quán, giúp loại bỏ những phức tạp thường gặp khi quản lý trạng thái cục bộ trong từng thành phần riêng lẻ. Redux hoạt động dựa trên ba nguyên tắc cơ bản: một kho lưu trữ duy nhất (single source of truth), trạng thái chỉ có thể đọc (state is read-only), và những thay đổi trong trạng thái được thực hiện thông qua các hàm thuần (pure functions) gọi là reducers. Kho lưu trữ (store) trong Redux chứa toàn bộ trạng thái của ứng dụng và là nguồn dữ liệu duy nhất, đảm bảo rằng tất cả các thành phần của ứng dụng có thể truy cập và tương tác với dữ liệu một cách nhất quán. Trạng thái trong Redux không thể bị sửa đổi trực tiếp, mà chỉ có thể được thay đổi bằng cách phát hành các hành động (actions) - là những đối tượng JavaScript mô tả sự thay đổi cần thực hiện. Reducers, một thành phần quan trọng khác của Redux, là các hàm thuần không có tác dụng phụ, nhận vào trạng thái hiện tại và một hành động, sau đó trả về trạng thái mới. Quá trình này đảm bảo rằng việc cập nhật trạng thái là hoàn toàn có thể dự đoán được và dễ kiểm soát. Redux cũng hỗ trợ mạnh mẽ việc ghi lại và theo dõi các thay đổi trạng thái thông qua DevTools, giúp các nhà phát triển dễ dàng xác định và gỡ lỗi các vấn đề phát sinh. Ngoài ra, Redux còn có khả năng mở rộng mạnh mẽ thông qua middleware, cho phép xử lý các tác vụ không đồng bộ như gọi API hoặc quản lý các tác vụ phức tạp khác. Middleware trong Redux như redux-thunk hay redux-saga cung cấp các phương pháp để xử lý các luồng điều khiển phức tạp, hỗ trợ tốt cho việc viết các ứng dụng có logic phức tạp nhưng vẫn giữ được tính minh bạch và dễ quản lý. Trong bối cảnh phát triển ứng dụng ngày càng phức tạp và yêu cầu về khả năng mở rộng cao, Redux trở thành một công cụ không thể thiếu, cung cấp một cách tiếp cận có tổ chức và hiệu quả để quản lý trạng thái, giúp các đội ngũ phát triển duy trì được chất lượng và hiệu suất của mã nguồn. Thêm vào đó, cộng đồng rộng lớn và tài liệu phong phú của Redux cũng mang lại nhiều lợi ích cho các nhà phát triển, từ việc học tập, trao đổi kinh nghiệm đến việc giải quyết các vấn đề cụ thể trong quá trình phát triển ứng dụng. Duolingo's gamified approach, while engaging and beneficial for vocabulary acquisition and phrase familiarity, presents limitations for users seeking to advance beyond beginner levels, as the platform's content for intermediate learners is relatively scarce. This can be attributed to its primary focus on maintaining user engagement through game-like features, which might overshadow the necessity for deeper linguistic competence and comprehensive grammatical instruction needed for more advanced proficiency. Despite these limitations, Duolingo's free access model continues to attract a wide user base, significantly contributing to its status as one of the most popular language learning applications globally. Its market strategy, emphasizing accessibility and user retention, capitalizes on the motivational aspects of gamification, thereby fostering an environment conducive to language learning for beginners. However, for learners aiming to achieve higher levels of language mastery, supplementary resources or platforms might be required to fill the gaps left by Duolingo's introductory-focused curriculum. This observation aligns with the findings from our survey, which indicate that while Duolingo excels in engaging new learners, it may not sufficiently address the needs of those progressing to more advanced stages of language acquisition. This underscores the importance of a diversified approach in language learning platforms, where a balance between engaging content and comprehensive educational material is crucial to cater to a broader spectrum of learner needs.

Encoded, or ciphered, manuscripts represent a unique class of historical documents characterized by their encrypted content. Automatically recognizing these documents is particularly challenging due to the variability of cipher alphabets across different manuscripts, the scarcity of annotated datasets for effective training, and the complexity introduced by overlapping symbols that complicate segmentation. To address these challenges, we introduce an innovative approach to handwritten cipher recognition utilizing few-shot object detection techniques. Our approach initially identifies all symbols from a specified alphabet within a line image, after which a decoding process translates symbol similarity scores into the final sequence of transcribed symbols. Through training on synthetically generated data, we demonstrate that our model can accurately recognize handwritten ciphers featuring previously unseen alphabets. Furthermore, when fine-tuned with a small number of labeled pages sharing the same alphabet, our approach outperforms current unsupervised and supervised handwriting text recognition (HTR) methods for ciphers.

The task of inferring, predicting, and controlling complex dynamical systems from time series data is crucial in fields such as financial markets, power grid operations, climate and weather forecasting, and molecular dynamics. Analyzing these nonlinear systems becomes more tractable because it is often possible to identify a (typically nonlinear) transformation of the system’s coordinates into features where the dynamics are well-represented by a linear Markovian model. Additionally, since many system variables exhibit collective behavior on broad temporal and spatial scales, the dynamics can often be effectively described within a low-dimensional feature space. This paper presents a variational approach for Markov processes (VAMP) designed to identify optimal feature transformations and Markovian models of the dynamics directly from time series data. The central idea is that the optimal linear model arises from the leading singular components of the Koopman operator. This insight leads to the development of a set of data-driven score functions, termed VAMP-r, which can be used to optimize Markovian models. Furthermore, by leveraging the connection between variational scores and Koopman operator approximation errors, the paper introduces a new VAMP-E score for use in cross-validation, hyper-parameter optimization, and model selection within VAMP. The VAMP framework is applicable to both reversible and nonreversible processes, as well as to stationary and non-stationary systems or data realizations.

Ngoài ra, việc tích hợp các cơ sở dữ liệu đa tầng, bao gồm dữ liệu lâm sàng, dữ liệu sinh học phân tử và dữ liệu hình ảnh y học, đã tạo ra môi trường nghiên cứu liên ngành giữa công nghệ thông tin và y sinh học, qua đó nâng cao hiệu quả và tính ứng dụng của các công nghệ mới trong thực tiễn y tế. Việc chuẩn hóa các định dạng dữ liệu gen và xây dựng các giao thức trao đổi dữ liệu đồng bộ giữa các hệ thống cũng đóng vai trò quan trọng trong việc nâng cao chất lượng và khả năng chia sẻ thông tin y tế trên phạm vi toàn cầu. Trong bối cảnh đó, các dự án hợp tác quốc tế về nghiên cứu gen và ung thư không ngừng được mở rộng, góp phần hình thành mạng lưới tri thức chung phục vụ mục tiêu chẩn đoán, điều trị và dự phòng bệnh ung thư một cách toàn diện và hiệu quả hơn. X-ray security screening is extensively employed to ensure the security of aviation and transportation, highlighting its critical role in automated screening systems. This paper seeks to review computerized X-ray security imaging algorithms by categorizing the domain into traditional machine learning and modern deep learning applications. The initial section offers a concise overview of classical machine learning techniques applied in X-ray security imaging, whereas the subsequent section provides an in-depth examination of contemporary deep learning methodologies. The proposed taxonomy further subdivides deep learning approaches into supervised, semi-supervised, and unsupervised learning, with an emphasis on tasks such as object classification, detection, segmentation, and anomaly detection. Additionally, the paper investigates well-established X-ray datasets and presents a performance benchmark. Drawing on current and emerging trends in deep learning, the paper concludes with a discussion and outlines prospective directions for research in X-ray security imagery.

These errors can lead to significant vulnerabilities within smart contracts, allowing malicious actors to exploit them for unauthorized transactions or data manipulation. Moreover, the immutable nature of blockchain exacerbates the consequences of such errors, as once a smart contract is deployed, it cannot be easily altered to correct mistakes. Consequently, developers must exercise rigorous testing and code review processes to identify and mitigate potential risks before deployment. Tools such as static code analyzers and formal verification methods are increasingly employed to enhance the security and reliability of smart contracts. Static code analyzers automatically scan the code for patterns that may indicate potential vulnerabilities, while formal verification employs mathematical methods to prove the correctness of smart contracts with respect to their specifications. The integration of these tools into the development workflow is crucial in preventing programming errors from compromising the integrity and functionality of smart contracts. Additionally, adopting best practices, such as comprehensive documentation and modular code design, can further minimize the likelihood of introducing errors. As the adoption of blockchain technology continues to grow, the importance of ensuring robust and error-free smart contracts becomes increasingly paramount in maintaining trust and efficiency in decentralized applications.

Process mining involves extracting knowledge from business process execution logs. Traditional process mining tasks, such as process model generation or conformance checking, rely on a minimalistic feature set, where each event is defined solely by its case identifier, activity type, and timestamp. Conversely, the success of modern machine learning hinges on models that utilize all available data as direct input, automatically constructing layers of features during training. In this work, we introduce ProcK (Process & Knowledge), a novel pipeline for building business process prediction models that integrate both sequential data from event logs and rich semantic information from a graph-structured knowledge base. This hybrid approach allows ProcK to flexibly utilize all information stored in organizational databases. The pipeline includes components for extracting inter-linked event logs and knowledge bases from relational databases. We demonstrate ProcK's efficacy by training it on the OULAD e-learning dataset, achieving state-of-the-art performance in predicting student dropout from courses and their success. Additionally, we apply our method to various machine learning tasks, including exam score prediction and early predictions based on data recorded during the initial weeks of courses.

In order to accurately identify and classify these errors, it is essential to analyze the visual features associated with each defect type. The bridge foot error typically manifests as an unintended connection between two adjacent pads, leading to short circuits and compromised circuit performance. Fat bridge errors are characterized by the presence of excessive solder between pins, which can similarly result in electrical connectivity issues or even component failure. Excess solder, on the other hand, is observed when an excessive amount of solder accumulates on a single joint, potentially causing mechanical instability or thermal stress. By utilizing advanced image processing techniques and deep learning-based segmentation models, such as convolutional neural networks (CNNs), it becomes possible to automatically distinguish between these error categories with high accuracy. Training the model on a diverse dataset that encompasses various lighting conditions, angles, and defect severities further enhances its generalizability and robustness, thereby improving the reliability of automated weld quality assessment systems.

Ngoài ra, việc tích hợp Ontology vào hệ thống còn hỗ trợ các tác vụ như phân loại tài liệu, gợi ý tài nguyên liên quan cũng như đáp ứng các truy vấn ngữ nghĩa phức tạp dựa trên cấu trúc chủ đề đã được định nghĩa. Qua đó, hệ thống không chỉ tăng cường hiệu quả quản lý dữ liệu chuyên ngành mà còn góp phần thúc đẩy hoạt động nghiên cứu và hợp tác liên ngành trong bối cảnh phát triển mạnh mẽ của kho tri thức số hiện nay.

Autonomous acquisition of robotic skills enables general-purpose robots to develop diverse behavioral capabilities without significant manual intervention. Nevertheless, most existing robotic skill learning approaches face various compromises for real-world applicability, such as dependence on handcrafted policy or value representations, reliance on human demonstrations for initialization, the need for specialized training environment setup, or prolonged training durations. In this work, we introduce a reinforcement learning algorithm designed to learn manipulation skills by training general-purpose neural network policies with minimal human involvement, while maintaining rapid and efficient learning in stochastic settings. Our method extends the guided policy search (GPS) framework, reformulating reinforcement learning as supervised learning guided by a computational teacher, eliminating the need for human demonstrations. Unlike previous GPS variants, which necessitate resetting the system to a fixed set of initial states after each episode, our algorithm accommodates randomized initial states, thus making it suitable for scenarios where deterministic resets are infeasible. Through simulation experiments, we demonstrate that our approach can train high-dimensional neural network policies with sample efficiency comparable to established GPS methods, and we validate its effectiveness on a PR2 robotic manipulator in real-world tasks.

We introduce DeepV2D, an end-to-end deep learning framework designed to estimate depth from video sequences. DeepV2D integrates the representational strengths of neural networks with the underlying geometric rules of image formation. A series of traditional geometric algorithms are transformed into learnable components and assembled into a fully differentiable, end-to-end architecture. The method alternates between motion estimation and depth estimation in an interleaved manner. During inference, these alternating processes iteratively refine and achieve precise depth predictions. Code is available https://github.com/princeton-vl/DeepV2D.

Trong hệ thống này, frontend dành cho người dùng và người quản lý, backend bao gồm các dịch vụ liên quan đến chứng thư và ký văn bản, SoftHSM và CA (Certificate Authority). Backend web là nơi tiếp nhận yêu cầu từ người dùng, tương tác với các dịch vụ khác để thực hiện yêu cầu. Thành phần Cert Manager chịu trách nhiệm quản lý các chứng thư và gửi yêu cầu ký đến dịch vụ ký, sau đó lưu trữ thông tin nhận được. Thành phần Sign Manager liên quan đến nghiệp vụ ký, tương tác với SoftHSM để lấy cặp khóa và chứng thư cho quá trình ký, kết nối với dịch vụ của VNPT để ký và cung cấp chứng thư công cộng. Hai thành phần CA: root và intermediate, là tổ chức chịu trách nhiệm cung cấp chứng thư nội bộ. Time Server Authority (TSA) cung cấp bằng chứng cho việc dữ liệu đã tồn tại trong một khoảng thời gian cụ thể và không bị thay đổi từ khi được ký. On Certificate Status Protocol (OCSP) được sử dụng bởi CA để kiểm tra trạng thái của chứng thư. Intermediate CA: Chứng thư trực tiếp từ CA gốc làm tăng nguy cơ bảo mật của chứng chỉ gốc, và nếu CA gốc bị tấn công, toàn bộ hạ tầng tin cậy xây dựng bởi các nhà cung cấp chứng thư sẽ bị ảnh hưởng. Việc sử dụng Intermediate CA để cấp chứng thư cung cấp một mức độ bảo mật bổ sung.

The HelpDesk system is designed to accommodate different user roles, each with distinct levels of access and interaction capabilities to ensure efficient ticket management and maintain data integrity. Customers, for instance, have limited access and can only view or close their tickets without the ability to modify any ticket details, thereby preventing unauthorized changes to ticket information. In contrast, administrators are empowered to receive tickets created by customers and assign them to appropriate agents for resolution, as illustrated in Figure 4.3: Package diagram for ticket management. This hierarchical access control is critical for streamlining the workflow and ensuring accountability within the system. Moving on to the user interface design, the portal screen serves as the entry point for users, featuring a login page equipped with a form that requires the input of essential credentials, namely Username and Password. Additionally, users must specify their role by choosing to log in either as a portal user or an internal user, which determines their access privileges and available functionalities within the HelpDesk system. This role-based authentication mechanism reinforces security by restricting access based on user roles, thereby safeguarding sensitive information and operational processes. The design of the user interface prioritizes usability and clarity, ensuring that users can easily navigate the system and perform their designated tasks efficiently. By integrating these design considerations, the HelpDesk application built using Odoo ERP not only facilitates effective ticket management but also enhances user experience through a structured and secure interaction model that caters to diverse user needs.

Status là trường dữ liệu lưu trữ trạng thái hiện thời của khóa học. Có 4 loại trạng thái cho khóa học trong hệ thống CMS: nháp, đã nộp, xuất bản, không xuất bản. Trạng thái nháp cho phép giảng viên hoặc người quản trị chỉnh sửa nội dung khóa học trước khi chính thức gửi để xét duyệt, trong khi trạng thái đã nộp biểu thị khóa học đang trong quá trình chờ phê duyệt. Khi khóa học được xét duyệt thành công, trạng thái sẽ chuyển sang xuất bản, cho phép người học truy cập và tham gia. Ngược lại, trạng thái không xuất bản chỉ ra rằng khóa học đã bị ẩn hoặc tạm ngừng cung cấp, do đó không hiển thị trong danh mục khóa học cho người dùng cuối. Việc quản lý trạng thái này giúp kiểm soát chặt chẽ quá trình phát triển và phân phối nội dung, đồng thời đảm bảo thông tin luôn được cập nhật và phù hợp với yêu cầu của hệ thống.

To address the limitations inherent in multi-class classification for smart contract vulnerability detection, recent research has begun to investigate multi-label classification methods capable of identifying multiple vulnerabilities within a single contract instance. Multi-label approaches are advantageous in the context of smart contracts, as they mirror the real-world scenario where a contract may simultaneously exhibit several types of vulnerabilities rather than being restricted to a singular category. For example, a contract might be susceptible to both reentrancy and integer overflow vulnerabilities, and traditional multi-class classifiers would fail to capture this concurrency. Furthermore, multi-label classification enables the development of more nuanced and comprehensive detection systems, which can provide developers with a holistic view of potential security flaws. The integration of advanced language models, such as transformer-based architectures, into these multi-label frameworks further enhances detection performance by leveraging contextual code representations and enabling the model to better understand complex vulnerability patterns. As such, the shift towards multi-label detection paradigms represents a significant advancement in the field, promising more robust and accurate vulnerability assessment for smart contracts, particularly as the complexity and diversity of contract logic continue to grow.

We conduct an empirical investigation into debiasing techniques for classifiers, revealing that these methods frequently fail to generalize effectively to out-of-sample data and may even exacerbate fairness issues rather than alleviate them. A thorough assessment of the impact of debiasing requires more extensive cross-validation than is typically performed. We attribute this issue to the bias-variance trade-off, where enforcing fairness constraints leads to increased variance. Subsequent experiments support the theoretical prediction that the estimation variance is highly influenced by the base rates of the protected group. Evaluating the trade-offs between fairness and performance supports the counterintuitive conclusion that partial debiasing can actually produce superior outcomes on out-of-sample data.

Pedestrian detection has greatly benefited from advancements in deep learning technology, leading to rapid progress in recent years. Most existing detectors adhere to the general object detection framework, which utilizes default boxes and a two-stage process. More recently, anchor-free and one-stage detectors have been introduced to this field; however, their accuracy remains unsatisfactory. To leverage both the simplicity of anchor-free detectors and the accuracy of two-stage methods, we propose several adaptations based on the Center and Scale Prediction (CSP) detector. The main contributions of our work are as follows: (1) we enhance the robustness of CSP and simplify its training process; (2) we introduce a novel method for width prediction, termed compressing width; (3) we achieve the second-best performance on the CityPersons benchmark, with a 9.3% log-average miss rate (MR) on the reasonable set, 8.7% MR on the partial set, and 5.6% MR on the bare set, thereby demonstrating that an anchor-free and one-stage detector can still attain high accuracy; and (4) we investigate certain capabilities of Switchable Normalization that were not discussed in its original paper.

By assigning each relationship a single label, current approaches formulate relationship detection as a classification problem, treating predicate categories as entirely distinct classes. However, unlike object labels, which have clear and explicit boundaries between classes, predicates frequently exhibit overlaps in their semantic meanings. For instance, sit\_on and stand\_on share commonalities in representing vertical relationships, yet differ in the specifics of how objects are positioned vertically. To leverage the inherent structure within predicate categories, we propose first constructing a language hierarchy and then employing the Hierarchy Guided Feature Learning (HGFL) strategy to learn more effective region features at both the coarse-grained and fine-grained levels. Additionally, we introduce the Hierarchy Guided Module (HGM), which utilizes the coarse-grained level to guide the learning of features at the fine-grained level. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed, simple yet effective method significantly improves several state-of-the-art baselines, achieving up to a 33\% relative gain in Recall@50 for the Scene Graph Generation task across different datasets.

In recent years, generative adversarial networks (GAN) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across various applications in computer vision and related areas. Given the rapid advancements in this field, it is highly likely that GANs will soon be capable of producing images and videos that are almost indistinguishable from genuine ones. However, the ability of GANs to create realistic images introduces significant security risks, particularly due to the potential proliferation of fake multimedia, highlighting the urgent necessity for robust multimedia forensic solutions. In this study, we demonstrate that each GAN imparts a unique fingerprint onto the images it produces, similar to how real-world cameras embed traces of their photo-response non-uniformity pattern into captured images. Experiments focused on source identification using several widely used GANs indicate that these fingerprints serve as a valuable resource for forensic investigations.

Classifying materials in natural environments poses a significant challenge due to the intricate interactions between geometry, reflectance properties, and lighting conditions. Historically, material classification has heavily depended on manually designed features extracted from visual samples. In this study, we utilize a Convolutional Neural Network (convnet) that autonomously learns detailed features tailored for material recognition. We specifically leverage transfer learning from object recognition tasks to train more effective features for material classification. This transfer learning approach using convnets achieves markedly higher recognition rates than previous top methods. Additionally, we examine the distinct contributions of reflectance and shading by decomposing images into their intrinsic components. The application of convnets for material classification has been limited by the need for abundant and varied training data, despite transfer learning. To address this, we introduce a novel dataset comprising roughly 10,000 images categorized into 10 distinct material groups.

Recent years have seen significant advances in reinforcement learning (RL), achieving notable success in various sequential decision-making tasks. Many successful RL applications—such as Go, Poker, robotics, and autonomous driving—involve multiple agents and thus fall within the scope of multi-agent RL (MARL). While MARL has a long history, it has recently regained attention due to progress in single-agent RL. Despite empirical successes, the theoretical foundations of MARL remain underdeveloped. In this chapter, we present a selective overview of MARL, focusing on algorithms supported by theoretical analysis. Specifically, we review theoretical results of MARL algorithms within two main frameworks—Markov/stochastic games and extensive-form games—organized by task types: fully cooperative, fully competitive, and mixed settings. We also highlight significant yet challenging applications of these algorithms. Distinct from existing reviews, we introduce new perspectives and taxonomies in MARL theory, including learning in extensive-form games, decentralized MARL with networked agents, MARL in the mean-field regime, and (non-)convergence of policy-based methods in games, some of which are based on our own research. Our aim is not only to assess the current state of the field but also to identify promising directions for future theoretical research in MARL. We hope this chapter will stimulate continued interest and research in this dynamic and challenging area.

First, determining the appropriate threshold value for various target domains can be challenging, as it depends on the similarity between the source and target domains—an aspect that is difficult to predict in advance. Second, selecting the threshold value for different categories presents another challenge. For example, objects such as traffic signs are rarely observed in the source domain, resulting in relatively low overall confidence scores for these rare categories. If the threshold is set too high, information from these rare categories may be ignored. Third, the pixel’s location also influences the threshold. For instance, pixels located at the center of an object, such as a car, are typically easier to predict accurately, while those on the edge of the object are more likely to yield ambiguous predictions. Therefore, it is difficult for a fixed threshold to accommodate these varying demands. To address these issues, CBST suggests using dynamic thresholds for each category, while an auxiliary loss is utilized to identify potentially noisy pseudo labels. Additionally, a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) is employed to fit the predictions to certainty and uncertainty modes, subsequently selecting trustworthy pseudo labels. Pseudo labels are then assigned to pixels classified within the certainty mode.

As computing power advances, raising the cost factor ensures that the hashing process remains sufficiently slow to deter attackers without significantly impacting legitimate users. Additionally, bcrypt generates a unique salt for each password hash, which is stored alongside the hash itself, ensuring that even identical passwords result in different hash outputs. This uniqueness further strengthens security by preventing attackers from leveraging precomputed hashes or identifying common passwords across different accounts. Consequently, bcrypt remains a widely recommended choice for securely storing passwords in web applications, including e-commerce platforms where protecting user credentials is critical.

Deep neural networks have achieved remarkable success in various domains, including medical image segmentation. Nevertheless, they are often criticized for their "black-box" nature, which impedes interpretation, understanding, and refinement of their architectures due to the lack of a general design theory. Precision learning has previously been proposed to integrate deep architectures with traditional approaches, thereby leveraging known operators to reduce parameter count and enhance interpretability. However, such networks do not consistently achieve state-of-the-art performance across all applications. In this study, we analyze deep networks through the lens of known operators by employing a divide-and-conquer strategy to systematically replace network components while maintaining performance. We focus on the task of retinal vessel segmentation, beginning with a high-performing U-Net architecture. Through stepwise conversion, we demonstrate that the network can be decomposed into modules of known operators. Our results show that a combination of a trainable guided filter and a trainable version of the Frangi filter achieves performance comparable to U-Net (AUC 0.974 vs. 0.972) while significantly reducing the number of parameters (111,536 vs. 9,575). Furthermore, the trained layers can be mapped back to their original algorithmic forms and analyzed using standard signal processing techniques.

The scope of this graduate thesis is to build an e-commerce website using React with key features such as user management, an intuitive and easy-to-use interface, order forms, on payment, and update product information. Developing this platform with React leverages its component-based architecture, allowing for reusable UI elements which enhance maintainability and scalability. User management will encompass authentication, authorization, and profile management, ensuring secure access and personalized experiences. The intuitive interface design will prioritize responsive layouts and accessibility standards to cater to diverse user demographics, particularly targeting luxury clothes consumers who expect seamless interactions. Order forms will integrate validation mechanisms to reduce errors during purchase, while the payment system will support multiple gateways to accommodate various transaction preferences securely. Updating product information will involve real-time database interactions, facilitating dynamic content management by administrators. In addition, the thesis research will also analyze the factors affecting the website design and propose appropriate solutions to improve performance. This includes examining load times, server response efficiency, and front-end optimization techniques such as code splitting and lazy loading to enhance user experience. Furthermore, the study will investigate the impact of visual aesthetics, navigation flow, and user feedback on customer satisfaction and retention in the competitive luxury e-commerce market. By integrating these elements, the project aims to deliver a robust, user-centric platform that meets both technical and business requirements effectively.

Bootstrap aggregation, or bagging, is a widely used ensemble technique in machine learning (ML), where multiple hypotheses are combined to create a single predictive model. In bagging, several classifiers are constructed using different sub-samples from the same dataset and then aggregated to form a robust classifier. Banks, particularly in retail banking, increasingly leverage ML algorithms such as decision trees and random forests to enhance operational efficiency. Nevertheless, the need to adhere to regulatory and governance standards presents significant challenges in deploying effective ML solutions. The process involves initial scrutiny by the bank’s validation and governance department, subsequent deployment in production, and finally, external validation by the national financial regulator. Every ML model must undergo validation, and transparent rules must justify all algorithm-driven decisions. To address these requirements, we introduce XtracTree, an algorithm designed to efficiently transform a bagging classifier—like a random forest—into straightforward "if-then" rules that fulfill model validation criteria. Using a public loan dataset from Kaggle, we demonstrate the practicality of our approach. Our results show that XtracTree enables the conversion of ML models into rule-based algorithms, facilitating simpler validation by both national regulators and internal validation teams. This method enabled our banking institution to cut the delivery time of AI solutions to end-users by up to 50%.

Kết quả học tập (KQHT) đóng vai trò quan trọng trong việc quyết định khả năng tìm việc và cơ hội nghề nghiệp của sinh viên. Đặc biệt, trong bối cảnh kỷ nguyên công nghệ và nền kinh tế suy thoái hiện nay, Trường Đại học Ngân hàng Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh (HUB) càng chú trọng đến việc nâng cao chất lượng đào tạo nhằm cung ứng nguồn nhân lực chất lượng cao, đáp ứng nhu cầu thị trường lao động. Nghiên cứu này phân tích mối quan hệ và mức độ ảnh hưởng của các nhân tố đến KQHT của sinh viên HUB thông qua phương pháp nghiên cứu định tính và định lượng. Nghiên cứu định tính được thực hiện thông qua phỏng vấn chuyên gia và thảo luận nhóm với 10 sinh viên, trong khi nghiên cứu định lượng được tiến hành dựa trên 619 phản hồi. Dữ liệu được phân tích bằng kiểm định độ tin cậy Cronbach’s Alpha qua phần mềm SPSS 20.0, cùng với mô hình PLS-SEM và các chỉ số AVE, HTMT, VIF thông qua phần mềm SmartPLS 4.0. Kết quả nghiên cứu cho thấy đặc điểm sinh viên và đặc điểm nhà trường đều có ảnh hưởng tích cực đến KQHT, trong đó đặc điểm sinh viên có tác động mạnh hơn. Nghiên cứu cũng đưa ra các hàm ý quản trị đối với nhà quản trị trường đại học, bao gồm việc đầu tư vào đội ngũ giảng viên, cơ sở vật chất và hoạt động tư vấn, cố vấn học tập. Ngoài ra, đối với sinh viên, việc chú trọng đến động lực, mục tiêu học tập và quá trình tự nhận thức về định hướng nghề nghiệp sẽ góp phần nâng cao KQHT.

Moving object detection represents a significant challenge within the field of computer vision. Event-based cameras, inspired by biological vision systems, emulate human ocular mechanisms and offer several advantages compared to traditional frame-based cameras, including reduced latency, high dynamic range (HDR), diminished motion blur under rapid movement, and lower power consumption. Despite these benefits, event-based cameras are characterized by heightened sensitivity to noise and limited spatial resolution. Furthermore, moving object detection using these sensors is particularly challenging, as event-based cameras register only binary changes in scene brightness and do not capture essential visual attributes such as texture and color. In this study, we explore the application of the k-means clustering algorithm for the detection of moving objects within event-based data. Experimental evaluations on publicly available datasets demonstrate that utilizing k-means yields substantial improvements in performance relative to current state-of-the-art approaches.

Consequently, this approach not only streamlines inventory processes but also aligns with organizational governance by enforcing compliance with internal protocols and external regulations. Moreover, the system is designed to be scalable, accommodating expansions in warehouse operations and varying organizational structures without compromising on security or functionality. This adaptability is critical in logistics environments where dynamic changes in inventory volume and workforce roles are commonplace, ensuring sustained operational continuity and responsiveness. Overall, the integration of user-specific access controls within the RFID-enabled automated inventory framework represents a significant advancement in logistics warehouse management, promoting an optimized balance between accessibility, security, and operational efficiency.

Khi một trạng thái thay đổi, React sẽ tạo ra một cây DOM ảo mới và so sánh nó với cây DOM ảo hiện tại, sử dụng thuật toán so sánh hiệu quả gọi là "reconciliation". Thuật toán này xác định các khác biệt giữa hai cây DOM ảo và chỉ ra những phần nào của DOM thực cần phải thay đổi. Điều này giúp tối ưu hóa đáng kể quá trình cập nhật giao diện người dùng, đặc biệt là trong các ứng dụng lớn và phức tạp. Hơn nữa, React còn cung cấp cơ chế "batching" để gom nhiều cập nhật trạng thái lại thành một lần cập nhật duy nhất, giảm thiểu số lần thao tác với DOM. Cùng với đó, React cũng có khả năng quản lý trạng thái thông qua các hooks như useState và useReducer, cho phép lập trình viên kiểm soát và quản lý trạng thái ứng dụng một cách hiệu quả và linh hoạt. Our experimental results demonstrate that incorporating KDFA and SSFA modules leads to consistent improvements in both clean image AP and adversarial robustness across multiple object detection architectures. Specifically, when equipped with the proposed feature alignment strategies, detectors such as Faster R-CNN and RetinaNet achieve higher resilience to various adversarial perturbations without sacrificing, and in some cases even enhancing, their performance on clean data. Ablation studies further reveal that KDFA and SSFA contribute complementary benefits, with KDFA leveraging knowledge distillation from a robust teacher model, and SSFA harnessing self-supervised objectives to encourage invariance in the learned representations. Qualitative analyses on PASCAL VOC and MS-COCO also illustrate that our approach enables detectors to maintain accurate localization and classification even under strong adversarial attacks. These findings suggest that feature alignment in intermediate layers is a promising direction for balancing the trade-off between clean accuracy and adversarial robustness in object detection tasks.

The transformation of the Newscorpus dataset into a pseudo multi-document dataset was achieved by carefully segmenting each document based on its length, which is a pivotal step in pretraining for Vietnamese text summarization. This segmentation approach not only expands the dataset but also introduces variability and complexity that mimic the characteristics of genuine multi-document datasets. By breaking down the documents into segments ranging from 2 to 5 parts, the dataset becomes more versatile, allowing for a more comprehensive training process. This method addresses the scarcity of multi-document datasets in the Vietnamese language and enhances the model's ability to summarize by exposing it to a wider range of contextual information. Furthermore, this strategy aids in improving the model's generalization capabilities, as it learns to handle varying lengths and complexities within the text, which is crucial for generating accurate and coherent summaries. Overall, the use of the Newscorpus dataset in this manner not only fills a significant gap in the resources available for Vietnamese NLP tasks but also sets a foundation for future research and development in this area.

Purpose – The study aims to examine the impact of migration on household consumption expenditure in Bangladesh. Design/methodology/approach – The paper employs crude matching methods to assess the causal relationship between migration and household welfare using the Bangladesh Household Income and Expenditure Survey 2010 dataset encompassing 12,213 households. Findings – The research indicates that migration positively influences household welfare by increasing their consumption expenditure. Households with migration status are observed to spend more on food and non-food items (housing, durable goods, fuel, cosmetics, cleaning, transportation, clothing, taxes, insurance, entertainment) and healthcare. However, the authors did not find any evidence of impact on educational expenditure. Research limitations/implications – The availability of panel data and the utilization of other variables (e.g., household investment expenditures, household budget allocation for agricultural input costs, etc.) could yield more comprehensive results. Originality/value – This paper contributes to the literature on Bangladeshi migration by offering a novel empirical assessment of Bangladeshi migrants and its impact on household welfare, based on a recently published sample of Bangladeshi households.

This study presents a video surveillance system designed to identify traffic events in videos captured by stationary cameras on highways. The events of concern involve specific sequences of occurrences in the video, such as a vehicle halting on the emergency lane. Consequently, detecting these events necessitates the analysis of temporal sequences within the video stream. We evaluate various methodologies utilizing architectures based on Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). One method extracts feature vectors, predominantly related to motion, from each video frame and feeds these into an RNN with the resultant sequence of vectors. Other approaches utilize the direct sequence of frames, which may be supplemented with pixel-wise motion data. This sequence is processed by an architecture that combines a CNN and an RNN, and we also explore a model based on transfer learning. The results are highly promising, and the most effective architecture will be subjected to online testing under real operational conditions.

This paper provides a concise overview of the field of Artificial Intelligence, focusing on the practical implementation of algorithms for object detection and tracking. The ability to accurately detect and track fast-moving objects is essential for numerous AI applications, including autonomous driving, sports analysis, robotics, and object counting. In this study, a Fully Convolutional Neural Network, "CueNet," was developed to robustly and reliably detect and track the cueball in a labyrinth game. CueNet V1 processes single input images, whereas CueNet V2 utilizes three consecutive 240 × 180-pixel images to generate a probability heatmap of the cueball's location. The networks were evaluated using a separate video containing various distractions to assess robustness. CueNet V1 achieved a correct cueball localization rate of 99.6% across all frames, while CueNet V2 reached an accuracy of 99.8%.

Most real-world knowledge graphs exhibit a long-tail relation frequency distribution, in which a substantial proportion of relations appear only a handful of times. This characteristic has spurred recent interest in low-shot learning methods capable of generalizing from limited examples. However, existing approaches are primarily designed for static knowledge graphs and do not readily extend to temporal settings, where data scarcity is even more pronounced, for instance, due to the emergence of new, previously unseen relations. To address this limitation, we propose a one-shot learning framework for link prediction in temporal knowledge graphs. Our method leverages a self-attention mechanism to effectively encode temporal interactions between entities and employs a network to compute a similarity score between a given query and a (one-shot) example. Experimental results demonstrate that our algorithm outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on two well-studied benchmarks and achieves significantly improved performance for sparse relations.

Rust’s ecosystem includes libraries like wasm-bindgen and web-sys, which facilitate seamless integration between Rust code and JavaScript, making it easier to implement high-performance cryptographic operations within browsers. The ability to audit and formally verify Rust code further enhances trust in the implementation of sensitive security features required for Web3 authentication systems.
