Our experiments include comparisons with leading disentanglement and zero-shot synthesis models, where GZS-Net consistently achieves superior performance in both reconstruction fidelity and attribute transfer accuracy. Notably, the disentangled representations learned through GSL exhibit enhanced interpretability, enabling intuitive manipulation of individual attributes without degrading other aspects of the synthesized images. Additionally, ablation studies confirm the critical role of group-wise supervision in encouraging the model to factorize object attributes effectively, distinguishing it from conventional sample-wise supervision approaches. We further analyze the generalization capabilities of GZS-Net by evaluating its performance on unseen attribute combinations and novel object categories, demonstrating robust zero-shot synthesis capabilities. This suggests that GSL fosters a more flexible and compositional understanding of visual concepts, akin to primate visual cognition. Our open-source dataset, designed to challenge attribute disentanglement and recombination, serves as a valuable benchmark for future research in this domain. Overall, our work advances the state of visual representation learning by bridging the gap between biological vision and artificial neural networks through a principled group-supervised paradigm.

Quá trình phát triển của tóc được điều hòa bởi hoạt động của tế bào gốc. Khi các tế bào gốc phân chia, nang tóc sẽ tạo ra sợi tóc mới theo một chu kỳ tuần hoàn, trong đó sau mỗi đợt mọc tóc, tế bào gốc trải qua giai đoạn “ngủ đông” hay trạng thái bất hoạt, chờ đợi đến chu kỳ hoạt động tiếp theo. Vi môi trường của tế bào gốc (stem cell niche) chứa các yếu tố tương tác với tế bào gốc nhằm điều hòa hoạt động của chúng, thay đổi biểu hiện gen và thúc đẩy sự tăng sinh hoặc biệt hóa của các mô cần thiết. Vào cuối tháng 6/2023, Tạp chí Nature đã công bố một nghiên cứu trên mô hình chuột phân tích hiện tượng các nốt sắc tố (nốt ruồi) trên da tăng cường hoạt động tế bào gốc, dẫn đến tăng tốc độ mọc lông/tóc; hiện tượng này cũng được ghi nhận tương tự ở các nốt ruồi trên da người. Trong nghiên cứu, các tác giả thảo luận về cơ chế khi tế bào sắc tố (melanocyte) bước vào giai đoạn lão hóa, các tín hiệu từ ổ tế bào gốc có thể bị biến đổi, kích hoạt tế bào gốc trong nang chuyển sang trạng thái tăng động, dẫn đến hiện tượng mọc lông/tóc quá mức (hình 1). Nhóm nghiên cứu do các nhà khoa học thuộc Đại học California (Mỹ) đứng đầu vừa phát hiện một cơ chế phân tử mới kích thích mọc tóc, mở ra khả năng xây dựng lộ trình trị liệu phân tử hoàn toàn mới, mang lại hy vọng cho những người bị rụng tóc do nội tiết tố ở cả nam và nữ. Kết quả nghiên cứu đã được công bố trên Tạp chí Nature* vào cuối tháng 6 vừa qua.

Recent advancements have introduced numerous reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms employing function approximation. Despite clear distinctions in their algorithmic frameworks, these methods often differ in implementation aspects that are independent of the algorithms themselves and frequently receive insufficient attention. This intermingling of algorithmic innovation with implementation expertise complicates the precise analysis of factors driving performance enhancements among different algorithms. In this study, we concentrate on a set of off-policy inference-based actor-critic algorithms—MPO, AWR, and SAC—to disentangle their algorithmic contributions from implementation choices. We provide unified derivations based on a single control-as-inference objective, enabling classification of each algorithm as rooted either in Expectation-Maximization (EM) or direct Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence minimization, while treating other elements as implementation specifics. Through comprehensive ablation experiments, we reveal significant performance declines when implementation details are misaligned with algorithmic decisions. Our findings highlight which implementation components have co-adapted alongside particular algorithms and which can be transferred between them; for instance, tanh Gaussian policies and network sizes are closely tailored to specific algorithm types, whereas layer normalization and ELU activation functions are vital for MPO's success and also yield notable improvements in SAC. We anticipate that this work will motivate further investigations to clarify the sources of performance gains across various algorithms, facilitating the integration of both algorithmic and implementation advancements in future research.

Recurrent neural networks (RNNs) are particularly well-suited for modeling nonlinear dependencies within dynamical systems based on observed time series data. In practical applications, especially in economic forecasting, not all external variables influencing such systems are known in advance. To address this limitation, a specialized class of RNNs known as Error Correction Neural Networks (ECNNs) was developed to compensate for missing input variables by incorporating feedback of the error from the previous time step into the current step. The ECNN model is implemented in Python through the calculation of appropriate gradients and is evaluated using stock market prediction tasks. As anticipated, it outperformed traditional RNNs, long short-term memory networks (LSTMs), and other hybrid models that utilize a de-noising preprocessing step, which is intuitively disadvantageous as de-noising may result in the loss of critical information.

Vehicle re-identification (ReID) is pivotal in the perception systems of autonomous driving, garnering increasing attention in recent years. However, to the best of our knowledge, a comprehensive solution for the surround-view system mounted on vehicles does not currently exist. In this paper, we identify two primary challenges within the aforementioned scenario: i) Within a single camera view, recognizing the same vehicle from past image frames is challenging due to fisheye distortion, occlusion, truncation, among other factors. ii) Across multiple camera views, the appearance of the same vehicle varies significantly from different cameras' perspectives. To address these issues, we introduce an integrated vehicle ReID solution. Specifically, we propose a novel quality evaluation mechanism to balance the effects of tracking box drift and target consistency. Additionally, we utilize a ReID network based on an attention mechanism, combined with a spatial constraint strategy, to enhance performance across different cameras. The experiments demonstrate that our solution attains state-of-the-art accuracy while maintaining real-time applicability. Furthermore, we will release the code and annotated fisheye dataset for the benefit of the community.

This study introduces an innovative weakly-supervised semantic segmentation technique that utilizes solely image-level labels. Class-specific activation maps derived from well-trained classifiers are employed as indicators to train a segmentation network. Acknowledged shortcomings of these indicators include their coarseness and incompleteness. To address these issues, super-pixel methods are applied for refinement, and cues obtained from both a color image trained classifier and a gray image trained classifier are integrated to mitigate incompleteness. Additionally, a conditional random field is employed to modulate the training procedure and further refine the outputs. The classifier, once trained, not only initializes the segmentation network but is also utilized during the testing phase to suppress non-existent classes. Experimental findings on the PASCAL VOC 2012 dataset demonstrate the efficacy of this approach.

Safe exploration is essential for the practical deployment of reinforcement learning (RL) systems. Prior research typically addresses safe exploration using the Constrained Markov Decision Process (CMDP) framework, optimizing policies under explicit constraints. However, in contrast to these approaches, humans often respond to imminent danger by immediately halting, rather than gradually learning safer behaviors in hazardous situations. Inspired by this human tendency, we propose a novel methodology for safe RL based on the Early Terminated Markov Decision Process (ET-MDP) framework. We formally define ET-MDP as an unconstrained MDP that shares the same optimal value function as its corresponding CMDP. To solve ET-MDPs, we introduce an off-policy algorithm leveraging context models, which consequently addresses the associated CMDP with superior asymptotic performance and enhanced learning efficiency. Experimental results on a range of CMDP benchmark tasks demonstrate significant improvements over previous approaches that directly optimize CMDPs.

Phương pháp Recursive XY Cut được JOE. Hart. Haralck và I. Phelps đề xuất tận dụng các hộp bao (bounding boxes) của các thành phần liên thông (connected components) để thực hiện phân đoạn tài liệu hiệu quả. Cụ thể, thuật toán bắt đầu bằng cách xác định các thành phần liên thông trên ảnh tài liệu đầu vào, sau đó tính toán hộp bao cho từng thành phần này. Dựa trên vị trí và kích thước của các hộp bao, thuật toán tiến hành cắt chia tài liệu theo hai hướng X và Y một cách đệ quy nhằm tách biệt các khối văn bản lớn như đoạn, cột hoặc khung hình. Quá trình đệ quy này tiếp tục cho đến khi các khối được phân tách hoàn toàn và không còn khả năng chia nhỏ thêm. Phương pháp này đặc biệt hiệu quả trong việc phân tích cấu trúc tài liệu phức tạp có nhiều cột hoặc các khối văn bản rõ ràng, giúp nhận diện chính xác các vùng nội dung riêng biệt mà vẫn bảo toàn bố cục tổng thể. Ngoài ra, Recursive XY Cut còn giảm thiểu sự phụ thuộc vào các thông số ngưỡng cố định, từ đó thích ứng tốt hơn với nhiều định dạng tài liệu khác nhau, góp phần nâng cao độ chính xác trong các bài toán nhận dạng và trích xuất thông tin từ tài liệu số hóa.

To begin with, spectral decomposition allows for a detailed examination of how the feature representations evolve as new relations are continually learned. By decomposing the covariance matrix of the learned features, it is possible to observe shifts in the eigenvalue distribution, which reflect changes in the variance captured by different principal components. Notably, the Cross-entropy loss tends to encourage feature representations that are highly discriminative for the current task but may lead to overfitting, reducing the transferability of these features to future tasks. This phenomenon manifests as a decrease in the diversity of learned features, where certain dimensions dominate the representation space, causing catastrophic forgetting when new relations are introduced. To address this issue, I propose a feature decorrelation regularization term that penalizes correlations among feature dimensions during training. This regularization encourages the model to learn more diverse and transferable features by promoting an orthogonal feature space, thus alleviating the negative effects associated with the Cross-entropy loss. Experimental results demonstrate that incorporating this regularization not only improves the generalization on seen relations but also significantly enhances performance on newly introduced relations in continual learning scenarios, confirming the efficacy of the proposed method.

To ensure the robustness and security of the system, I integrated Shamir’s secret sharing algorithm and the verified Distributed Key Generation (DKG) protocol through collaboration with experts in cryptographic implementations. These components are critical for distributing trust among multiple participants, thereby mitigating single points of failure and enhancing the resilience of the social login mechanism in the Web3 environment. Furthermore, I conducted extensive testing and optimization of the smart contracts and Eueno storage to guarantee efficient performance and scalability under real-world conditions. The resulting architecture not only preserves user privacy and data integrity but also facilitates a smooth onboarding process by allowing users to authenticate through familiar social login providers without compromising decentralization principles. This approach bridges the gap between traditional Web2 authentication methods and the emerging decentralized ecosystem, offering a practical solution for developers aiming to integrate secure and user-friendly login functionalities into their Dapps.

Phân tích tham số cũng chỉ ra rằng, khi cường độ bê tông tăng, khả năng kháng cắt của sàn phẳng tăng lên đáng kể, tuy nhiên mức độ cải thiện có xu hướng giảm dần khi đạt đến một giá trị ngưỡng nhất định. Các kết quả này góp phần làm rõ hơn vai trò của các thông số vật liệu đối với cơ chế phá hoại cắt thủng sàn phẳng và có thể làm cơ sở để hiệu chỉnh, cập nhật các công thức thiết kế trong tiêu chuẩn hiện hành.

Đặc biệt, Flutter cung cấp khả năng tạo giao diện người dùng linh hoạt và thẩm mỹ cao, cho phép việc xây dựng ứng dụng đa nền tảng trở nên nhanh chóng và dễ dàng.

Bên cạnh những chức năng cơ bản đã đề cập, phần mềm còn được thiết kế với giao diện thân thiện, dễ sử dụng nhằm đáp ứng nhu cầu của đa dạng đối tượng người dùng, từ cá nhân không chuyên đến các doanh nghiệp có bộ phận công nghệ thông tin chuyên sâu. Quá trình lựa chọn nhà cung cấp dịch vụ điện toán đám mây sẽ được mô phỏng qua các bước điền thông tin yêu cầu, bao gồm quy mô hệ thống, ngân sách dự kiến, yêu cầu về bảo mật, khả năng mở rộng và các tiêu chí đặc thù khác, từ đó hệ thống sẽ xử lý, phân tích dữ liệu đầu vào bằng các thuật toán phù hợp để đưa ra danh sách các nhà cung cấp dịch vụ đáp ứng tốt nhất các tiêu chí này. Ngoài ra, phần mềm còn tích hợp chức năng đánh giá và xếp hạng các nhà cung cấp dựa trên các tiêu chí như độ tin cậy, chất lượng dịch vụ, mức độ bảo mật, giá cả, hỗ trợ kỹ thuật và trải nghiệm người dùng thực tế, giúp người dùng có cái nhìn tổng quát và khách quan khi ra quyết định. Hệ thống cũng cho phép người dùng tự do đóng góp đánh giá, nhận xét cũng như cập nhật thông tin mới về các nhà cung cấp, từ đó xây dựng được một kho dữ liệu mở, liên tục được cộng đồng cập nhật và hoàn thiện. Đặc biệt, chức năng so sánh trực quan giữa hai nhà cung cấp bất kỳ giúp người dùng dễ dàng nhận diện điểm khác biệt về giá thành, tính năng, vùng phủ sóng dịch vụ, chính sách hỗ trợ, mức độ đáp ứng các tiêu chuẩn quốc tế về an toàn thông tin và bảo mật dữ liệu. Bên cạnh đó, phần mềm còn hỗ trợ chức năng hỏi đáp với chuyên gia, qua đó người dùng có thể gửi các câu hỏi cụ thể liên quan đến nhu cầu sử dụng, nhận được các tư vấn chuyên sâu và giải pháp tối ưu phù hợp với thực tiễn hoạt động của mình. Để đảm bảo tính bảo mật và riêng tư thông tin người dùng, hệ thống được xây dựng trên nền tảng công nghệ hiện đại, áp dụng các giải pháp mã hóa dữ liệu, xác thực đa yếu tố và phân quyền truy cập linh hoạt. Với định hướng phát triển lâu dài, phần mềm cũng được thiết kế mở, cho phép tích hợp thêm nhiều tính năng mới như dự đoán chi phí sử dụng dịch vụ theo thời gian, cập nhật xu hướng công nghệ điện toán đám mây, cảnh báo rủi ro về bảo mật và tuân thủ các quy định pháp luật liên quan đến dữ liệu số. Nhờ đó, phần mềm không chỉ là công cụ hỗ trợ lựa chọn nhà cung cấp mà còn trở thành một nền tảng thông tin hữu ích, góp phần thúc đẩy quá trình chuyển đổi số tại Việt Nam, nâng cao khả năng tiếp cận và sử dụng các dịch vụ điện toán đám mây trong cộng đồng doanh nghiệp. Qua đó, cá nhân và tổ chức có thể tối ưu hóa hoạt động, nâng cao hiệu quả kinh doanh và chủ động thích ứng với sự phát triển nhanh chóng của công nghệ thông tin trong thời đại 4.0.

Building upon the foundational ideas introduced by Pennington et al., the integration of word embeddings such as GloVe into federated learning frameworks offers promising avenues for enhancing model performance, especially in natural language processing tasks where distributed data heterogeneity poses significant challenges. Recent research has explored how pre-trained embeddings can be leveraged to initialize local models, thereby facilitating more stable and rapid convergence during collaborative training rounds. Furthermore, the ability of GloVe embeddings to capture global statistical information from large corpora aligns well with the objectives of federated learning systems, which often operate over decentralized datasets with non-IID characteristics. By incorporating such global representations, federated models may benefit from improved generalization across diverse client data, mitigating the adverse effects of client drift and uneven class distributions. Điều này được thực hiện thông qua các công nghệ tiên tiến như thực tế ảo và thực tế tăng cường, giúp tái tạo các không gian triển lãm một cách chân thực và sống động nhất. Ngoài ra, hệ thống còn tích hợp các công cụ hỗ trợ giao dịch như hợp đồng thông minh và blockchain, đảm bảo tính minh bạch và bảo mật trong các giao dịch mua bán tác phẩm nghệ thuật. Các tác phẩm được mã hóa và lưu trữ trên blockchain, giúp bảo vệ quyền sở hữu trí tuệ và ngăn chặn các hành vi sao chép trái phép. Hệ thống cũng hỗ trợ các chức năng xã hội, cho phép người dùng theo dõi các nghệ sĩ yêu thích, trao đổi ý kiến và bình luận về các tác phẩm. Điều này không chỉ thúc đẩy sự tương tác giữa nghệ sĩ và người xem mà còn tạo ra một cộng đồng nghệ thuật sôi động và đa dạng. Furthermore, network scalability and congestion issues affect smart contracts on open blockchains. The transaction costs may rise and the processing times maylengthen during times of intense network activity. The effectiveness of data retrieval from smart contracts may be further impacted by this, particularly for appli cations that require real-time data or large query rates.b, Solution The difficulty of efficiently requesting data from smart contracts has given rise to products like The Graph (GRT). In order to index, arrange, and efficiently query data from blockchain networks, including data contained in smart contracts, The Graph offers a decentralized protocol and network. The Graph works by allowing developers to build and publish open APIs, called subgraphs, which define how blockchain data should be indexed and made available for efficient retrieval. Subgraphs help to streamline the process of accessing specific events, states, and transactions from smart contracts without having to scan the entire blockchain repeatedly, thus significantly reducing latency and computational overhead for decentralized applications (dApps). By offloading the data indexing and querying workload to a decentralized network of indexers and curators, The Graph ensures that query performance remains robust even as blockchain data grows in volume or network congestion increases. This is particularly important for a decentralized video sharing website, where metadata such as video ownership, upload timestamps, and access permissions must be queried quickly to provide a seamless user experience. Additionally, by leveraging The Graph's decentralized approach, the platform avoids reliance on centralized servers, enhancing the resilience and censorship resistance of the application. The protocol's incentive mechanisms also promote data accuracy and availability, as participants are rewarded for providing reliable indexing and query services, further mitigating the risks posed by network congestion and scalability limitations inherent to open blockchains.

Pre-training is essential for learning deep neural networks. Most existing pre-training methods involve training simple models, such as restricted Boltzmann machines, and stacking them layer by layer to create the deep structure. This layer-wise pre-training has a strong theoretical foundation and broad empirical support. However, employing this method to pre-train models without a clear multi-layer structure, such as recurrent neural networks (RNNs), is challenging. This paper introduces a new pre-training approach based on knowledge transfer learning. Unlike the layer-wise approach, which trains model components incrementally, the new method trains the entire model simultaneously but with a simpler objective function. This is accomplished by using soft targets produced by a previously trained model (teacher model). Compared to conventional layer-wise methods, this new approach is independent of model structure, making it suitable for pre-training very complex models. Experiments on a speech recognition task demonstrated that this approach allows complex RNNs to be effectively trained with a weaker deep neural network (DNN) model. Moreover, the new method can be combined with conventional layer-wise pre-training to achieve additional improvements.

We aim to combine RCutMix and RClassMix due to the unique benefits each offers. To achieve this, we randomly select either method to execute the mixing process with source and target images. As shown in the table, these two strategies complement and enhance each other, achieving superior performance compared to using either method alone (55.03 %mIoU versus 54.78 %mIoU and 52.34 %mIoU). The combination of RCutMix and RClassMix effectively addresses the limitations encountered by each individual method.

In summary, our study advances the field of unsupervised representation learning by introducing SlowVAE, a model that effectively disentangles generative factors from videos with complex and naturalistic dynamics, overcoming key limitations of prior work that relied on artificially constrained datasets. The identifiability proof and extensive empirical results underscore the robustness and reliability of the learned representations, while the introduction of the Natural Sprites and KITTI Masks datasets opens new avenues for benchmarking and improving disentanglement methods in more realistic settings. Collectively, these contributions not only establish a new state-of-the-art for unsupervised disentanglement but also provide practical tools and insights for developing machine learning models that generalize to natural environments, facilitating progress in domains such as video understanding, robotics, and autonomous systems.

The pursuit of effective neural networks is a vital and practical area within deep learning. Beyond deciding on the depth, convolution type, normalization, and nonlinearities, the topological connectivity of neural networks plays a crucial role. While previous rule-based modular design principles have simplified the challenge of constructing effective architectures, they also limit possible topologies to constrained spaces. In this study, we aim to enhance the connectivity optimization in neural networks. We introduce a topological perspective, representing a network as a complete graph for analytical purposes, where nodes execute the aggregation and transformation of features, and edges dictate the information flow. By assigning learnable parameters to the edges that indicate the strength of connections, the learning process becomes differentiable. Additionally, we incorporate an auxiliary sparsity constraint on the distribution of connectivity, encouraging the learned topology to emphasize essential connections. This learning method is compatible with existing networks and is adaptable to larger search spaces and various tasks. Experimental quantitative results demonstrate that the learned connectivity surpasses traditional rule-based methods, such as random, residual, and complete. Furthermore, it achieves notable improvements in image classification and object detection without adding significant computational demands.

Hệ thống ra hoa in vitro là một công cụ hữu ích trong nghiên cứu quá trình ra hoa và sản xuất hoa in vitro thương mại. Nghiên cứu này tiến hành đánh giá ảnh hưởng của các chất điều tiết sinh trưởng thực vật (BA và TDZ) và chất khoáng vi lượng (AgNO3 và CoCl2) đến sự sinh trưởng và ra hoa in vitro trên ba giống hồng (HV, HD, HT). Kết quả cho thấy các yếu tố khảo sát đều ảnh hưởng đến sự sinh trưởng, nhưng chỉ có TDZ và AgNO3 tác động đến sự cảm ứng ra hoa. Trên môi trường MS bổ sung 0,2 mg/l TDZ, chỉ có giống hoa hồng HV cảm ứng ra hoa với tỉ lệ 72,2%. Trong khi đó, trên môi trường bổ sung 30 µM AgNO3, sau 21-25 ngày, cả ba giống HT, HV và HD đều ra hoa với tỉ lệ lần lượt là 30%, 40% và 50%; độ bền hoa kéo dài khoảng 14-16 ngày.

EUENO revolutionizes a variety of ways we can work with data for the better through end-to-end encryption using cryptography, including freely contributing to a peer-to-peer network of encrypted files without putting one’s ownership at risk, sparing oneself from using up a lot of storage space exclusively, broadcasting encrypted data to different networks, and many more. This innovative approach not only enhances data security by ensuring that only authorized parties can access the information but also promotes data integrity and privacy. By utilizing advanced cryptographic techniques, EUENO allows users to maintain control over their data, offering a robust solution against unauthorized data breaches and cyber threats. Furthermore, the system's peer-to-peer architecture decentralizes data storage and distribution, significantly reducing the risk of data loss and providing a resilient framework that can adapt to various data management needs. This model also encourages collaborative data sharing, where users can confidently share their data without the fear of compromising its confidentiality. Additionally, the ability to broadcast encrypted data across multiple networks enhances the efficiency of data dissemination, enabling seamless communication and integration across different platforms. As data continues to grow exponentially, EUENO's approach to secure data handling and transmission becomes increasingly relevant, providing a scalable and sustainable solution for modern data management challenges.

Recent works in attributed network clustering employ graph convolution to generate node embeddings while simultaneously performing clustering assignments in the embedding space. This approach is effective because graph convolution integrates both structural and attribute information during node embedding learning. Nevertheless, a significant limitation of these methods is that graph convolution considers only the attribute information from the local neighborhoods of nodes and fails to leverage the mutual affinities between nodes and attributes. To address this issue, we propose a variational co-embedding learning model for attributed network clustering (VCLANC). VCLANC comprises dual variational auto-encoders that simultaneously embed nodes and attributes, enabling the reconstruction of mutual affinity information between nodes and attributes from the embedding space. This reconstructed information provides additional self-supervised knowledge to enhance representation learning. Furthermore, we employ a trainable Gaussian mixture model as priors to infer node clustering assignments. To further improve cluster quality, we introduce a mutual distance loss on the centers of the Gaussian priors and a clustering assignment hardening loss on the node embeddings. Experimental results on four real-world attributed network datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed VCLANC for attributed network clustering.

Việc đo lường năng lực thích ứng (NLTƯ) với biến đổi khí hậu (BĐKH) thông qua chỉ số tổng hợp đã được triển khai rộng rãi trên thế giới, nhưng tại Việt Nam, đặc biệt là tại cấp huyện, ứng dụng này vẫn còn hạn chế. Nghiên cứu này sử dụng dữ liệu thứ cấp từ các cơ quan thống kê để xây dựng chỉ số tổng hợp nhằm đo lường NLTƯ với BĐKH cho cấp huyện tại ba tỉnh ven biển thuộc Đồng bằng sông Cửu Long (ĐBSCL), bao gồm Bến Tre, Trà Vinh và Sóc Trăng, bằng cách áp dụng hai phương pháp: gia trọng bằng nhau và gia trọng theo phân tích nhân tố. Kết quả từ cả hai phương pháp cho thấy, hơn 95% trong số 29 huyện thuộc ba tỉnh này có NLTƯ chỉ đạt mức thấp đến trung bình. Bên cạnh đó, chỉ số tổng hợp cũng cho phép xếp hạng 29 đơn vị hành chính cấp huyện theo NLTƯ. Đây được xem là công cụ quan trọng giúp các cấp chính quyền địa phương đưa ra quyết định ưu tiên trong việc đầu tư cho các chương trình hành động thích ứng với BĐKH trong tương lai. Chỉ số này có thể dễ dàng cập nhật dựa trên dữ liệu có sẵn, tạo điều kiện thuận lợi cho việc giám sát và đánh giá thứ bậc NLTƯ tại cấp huyện theo thời gian.

In the Model-View-Controller (MVC) architecture, the Controller serves as a crucial intermediary, facilitating interaction between the Model and the View. Its primary function is to manage user requests and interact with the Model to obtain necessary data. Subsequently, it conveys this data to the View for presentation. Within the Angular framework, components are utilized to embody Controller logic. These components are responsible for handling user events, executing API calls to the Model via the HTTP client, and delivering data to the View through variables or data-binding mechanisms. The Controller layer effectively encapsulates the application's business logic, ensuring seamless coordination between the Model and the View.

Controller là thành phần bao gồm các lớp và hàm được thiết kế để xử lý logic nghiệp vụ. Nó có chức năng lấy dữ liệu thông tin cần thiết từ các lớp nghiệp vụ mà Model cung cấp. Sau đó, Controller sẽ hiển thị dữ liệu này cho người dùng thông qua lớp View.

The Stacked LSTM-GRU Model employs a configuration option, denoted as LG, to specify the stacking order of the LSTM and GRU layers. ReactJS là một thư viện JavaScript phổ biến và mạnh mẽ được sử dụng rộng rãi để xây dựng giao diện người dùng động và tương tác trên web. The incorporation of nonlinearity is essential for accurately forecasting the future states of dynamical systems, assessing their responses to shocks, and revealing their underlying causal structures. Despite this necessity, prevailing methods for causality detection and impulse response analysis, such as Vector Autoregression (VAR), generally assume linear relationships and thus fall short in capturing system complexity. In this study, we propose a vector autoencoder nonlinear autoregression neural network (VANAR) that enables both automated time series feature extraction and estimation of functional forms. The performance of VANAR is assessed in three dimensions: forecast accuracy, accuracy in detecting true causal relationships among variables, and impulse response modeling of trajectories under external shocks. These evaluations are conducted using a simulated nonlinear chaotic system as well as empirical Philippine macroeconomic data. The results indicate that VANAR substantially outperforms VAR in both forecasting and causality detection tasks, and demonstrates consistently higher accuracy compared to contemporary models such as SARIMA and TBATS. In the impulse response analysis, neither model successfully predicts the shocked trajectories within the nonlinear chaotic system. Nonetheless, VANAR exhibits strong robustness in modeling a diverse array of dynamics, including chaotic regimes, environments with high noise and limited data, and macroeconomic systems.

Their research seeks to delineate the performance of various neural network architectures and identify the attributes that contribute to their effectiveness in summarization tasks. By analyzing diverse datasets and leveraging different model configurations, the authors aim to uncover the underlying mechanics that enhance summarization accuracy and efficiency. Additionally, the paper discusses potential avenues for future research, suggesting that incorporating more sophisticated linguistic features and experimenting with hybrid models could yield substantial improvements. These insights contribute significantly to the ongoing discourse in computational linguistics, emphasizing the dynamic interplay between technology and language understanding. As the field evolves, such foundational studies will likely guide the development of more advanced, context-aware summarization tools that can adeptly handle complex textual data.

Traditional image instance segmentation first detects objects and then segments them from bounding boxes. Recent deep learning methods like Mask R-CNN combine these steps. However, the "human" category is often overlooked despite its distinct feature: the pose skeleton. This skeleton can better handle heavy occlusion compared to bounding boxes. We propose a new pose-based instance segmentation framework for humans that uses human pose to separate instances instead of region proposal detection. Our framework shows improved accuracy over state-of-the-art detection-based methods and is more effective in managing occlusion. Additionally, there is a lack of public datasets with heavily occluded humans and comprehensive annotations, posing a challenge often ignored by researchers. To address this, we introduce the "Occluded Human (OCHuman)" benchmark, focusing on occluded humans with detailed annotations, including bounding boxes, human poses, and instance masks. This dataset comprises 8110 annotated human instances across 4731 images, with an average MaxIoU of 0.67 per person, making OCHuman the most complex and challenging dataset in human instance segmentation. We aim to highlight occlusion as a critical issue for research.

One of the primary obstacles in creating AI systems capable of strong generalization is enabling agents to independently discover relevant knowledge about their environment and effectively utilize that knowledge in scenarios where rewards are infrequent. Traditional reinforcement learning methods typically maintain a strict division between the processes of learning and making decisions, which contrasts with how learning occurs in biological systems. In response, we present an architecture that draws from experimental neuroscience by integrating computationally efficient models of biological learning mechanisms. This framework is influenced by studies on spike-timing dependent plasticity, the mechanisms governing the transition between short-term and long-term memory, and the influence of neurotransmitters that drive curiosity-driven behavior. The Neurons-in-a-Box architecture supports fully generalizable learning and provides an effective approach to constructing and leveraging representations without the need for explicit optimization across predefined objectives or action sets. Our results show that it achieves strong performance in a variety of tasks, such as OpenAI Gym's Mountain Car, where success depends on reaching a difficult-to-access flag, Inverted Pendulum, where the agent discovers strategies to maximize the duration of balancing a pendulum, as well as in video stream tasks, in which it autonomously differentiates between an open and closed hand, and in other settings like Google Chrome's Dinosaur Game.

Để đảm bảo giao dịch NFT diễn ra thành công và tài sản số được gửi về ví của tác nhân một cách an toàn, có một số yếu tố quan trọng cần được xem xét. Đầu tiên, việc xác minh tính xác thực của NFT là điều cần thiết. Tiếp theo, việc bảo mật ví điện tử của tác nhân cần được đặt lên hàng đầu. Sử dụng các biện pháp bảo mật mạnh mẽ như xác thực hai yếu tố, mã hóa ví và lưu trữ khóa riêng ở nơi an toàn sẽ giúp bảo vệ tài sản số khỏi các cuộc tấn công mạng. Thêm vào đó, việc hiểu rõ các điều khoản của nền tảng giao dịch NFT cũng rất quan trọng. Các nền tảng khác nhau có thể có các quy định và phí giao dịch khác nhau, do đó người tham gia cần đọc kỹ và nắm bắt được mọi chi tiết trước khi thực hiện giao dịch. Cuối cùng, việc theo dõi giao dịch sau khi thực hiện cũng cần được chú ý để đảm bảo rằng NFT đã được chuyển đến ví của tác nhân một cách chính xác. Bằng cách tuân thủ các bước trên, kỳ vọng giao dịch thành công và NFT được gửi về ví của tác nhân sẽ dễ dàng đạt được.

Mặc dù khối lượng dữ liệu thu thập được đáp ứng đủ nhu cầu sử dụng, việc phân loại dữ liệu vẫn chưa đạt được hiệu quả tối ưu do nguồn dữ liệu đa dạng và không đồng nhất về quy chuẩn phân loại. Mỗi nguồn dữ liệu áp dụng những tiêu chí phân loại riêng biệt, gây ra sự phức tạp trong việc tổng hợp và xử lý dữ liệu một cách thống nhất. Hiện tại, chưa có công cụ chuyên dụng nào hỗ trợ tự động phân loại dữ liệu một cách nhanh chóng và chính xác, dẫn đến việc phân loại chưa hoàn chỉnh toàn bộ nguồn dữ liệu. Điều này gây ra những hạn chế đáng kể trong việc cung cấp các gợi ý chính xác và phù hợp cho người dùng khi tìm kiếm thông tin thông qua các từ khóa. Việc chưa phân loại đầy đủ và hiệu quả nguồn dữ liệu cũng làm giảm khả năng khai thác triệt để giá trị thông tin ẩn chứa bên trong, ảnh hưởng trực tiếp đến chất lượng cũng như tính ứng dụng của hệ thống tìm kiếm. Ngược lại, nếu có thể phân loại dữ liệu một cách khoa học và hệ thống, sẽ mang lại nhiều lợi ích thiết thực như: nâng cao độ chính xác của kết quả tìm kiếm, rút ngắn thời gian truy xuất thông tin, cải thiện trải nghiệm người dùng qua việc cung cấp các đề xuất tìm kiếm có liên quan và phù hợp hơn với nhu cầu thực tế. Bên cạnh đó, việc phân loại dữ liệu còn hỗ trợ công tác quản lý, bảo trì dữ liệu dễ dàng hơn, giúp xác định nhanh chóng các nhóm dữ liệu có đặc điểm tương đồng, từ đó phát triển các thuật toán xử lý chuyên biệt nhằm tối ưu hóa hiệu suất hệ thống. Hơn nữa, phân loại dữ liệu hợp lý cũng tạo điều kiện thuận lợi cho việc mở rộng quy mô hệ thống trong tương lai, khi cần tích hợp thêm các nguồn dữ liệu mới hoặc áp dụng các kỹ thuật phân tích dữ liệu nâng cao như học máy và trí tuệ nhân tạo. Việc này đồng thời góp phần nâng cao tính minh bạch và nhất quán trong quá trình xử lý dữ liệu, đảm bảo dữ liệu đầu ra đạt chất lượng cao và đáng tin cậy phục vụ cho các mục tiêu nghiên cứu hoặc ứng dụng thực tế. Do đó, xây dựng một cơ chế phân loại dữ liệu hiệu quả và phù hợp với đặc thù từng nguồn dữ liệu là một bước đi cần thiết và có ý nghĩa quan trọng trong việc phát triển hệ thống hỗ trợ tìm kiếm thông tin hiện đại và hiệu quả.

We aim to assess, and where feasible demonstrate, the equivalence of two distinct artificial neural networks by constructing a data-driven transformation between them through manifold-learning techniques. Specifically, we utilize diffusion maps with a Mahalanobis-like metric. When such a transformation is successfully constructed, the networks can be regarded as members of the same equivalence class. Initially, we focus on transformation functions linking only the outputs of the networks, and subsequently extend our approach to transformations that incorporate the activations of several internal neurons from each network. According to Whitney's theorem, the number of measurements required from one network to reconstruct all features of the other is determined. The transformation function is built upon a consistent and intrinsic representation of the network input space. Our algorithm is demonstrated by aligning pairs of neural networks trained on (a) scalar function observations, (b) two-dimensional vector field observations, and (c) image representations of a moving three-dimensional object (a rotating horse). The formation of such equivalence classes among different network instances is closely related to transfer learning. Furthermore, we anticipate this approach will be useful for establishing equivalence between various Machine Learning-based models of the same phenomenon as observed by different instruments or research teams.

Pedestrian detection, a subset of object detection, has advanced significantly due to training on extensive labeled datasets. However, models trained on these generic datasets often perform poorly when applied directly to specific scenes. Specific scenes, characterized by unique viewpoints, lighting, and backgrounds, differ markedly from generic datasets. To enhance the performance of pedestrian detectors in these specific contexts, it is essential to adapt the models using labeled data from the specific scenes. However, manually labeling data is time-consuming and costly, particularly for new specific scenes, necessitating the labeling of large image volumes. Additionally, manual labeling often lacks precision at the pixel level, and inconsistencies arise from different individuals' labeling efforts. This paper introduces an ACP-based method utilizing augmented reality to construct virtual environments of specific scenes, simulating pedestrian movement in likely scenarios. This approach addresses the shortage of labeled data, demonstrating that data from virtual environments can effectively adapt generic pedestrian detectors to specific scenes.

Moreover, to generate positioning sequences, dBTS applies Linear feedback shift register algorithm, which is fast, but depends on finding a suitable primitivepolynomial first. This dependency arises because the linear feedback shift register (LFSR) relies on primitive polynomials to produce maximal length sequences, ensuring that the generated sequences have desirable properties such as balance and run-length constraints critical for quantum communication systems. The selection of primitive polynomials is non-trivial and can significantly impact the sequence quality and system performance. To determine the location of a subsequence in the whole positioning sequence, the system uses a look up table, which is a costly approach. This lookup table stores precomputed mappings of subsequences to positions, enabling rapid retrieval during communication, but requires substantial memory resources and can lead to increased latency, especially when dealing with large sequences typical in quantum communication protocols. Alternative methods to reduce the lookup table size or improve search efficiency, such as compressed representations or algorithmic indexing, may be explored to optimize performance. More details about the generate algorithm, look-up table, and the analysis of this system are presented in the next chapter.

Adversarial examples in deep neural networks have garnered growing attention due to their role in improving our understanding of, and reducing, network sensitivity to input variations. This focus is unsurprising, considering the widespread integration of deep neural networks into daily life. While white-box attacks are almost invariably successful, their assessment usually centers on the magnitude of perturbation distortion. In this study, we emphasize that attack speed is also crucial, particularly since rapid attacks are necessary for adversarial training. Iterative methods can always achieve superior solutions if given more time. We explore the trade-off between speed and distortion in detail and present a novel attack method, boundary projection (BP), which significantly advances current approaches. The central idea is to treat the classification boundary as a manifold within the image space, enabling a rapid approach to the boundary followed by optimization of distortion along this manifold.

Text detection in natural scenes using deep neural networks has achieved notable progress. Rather than relying on word-level bounding box regression, recent state-of-the-art approaches have shifted towards character bounding boxes and pixel-level predictions. This shift requires effective linking of adjacent characters, which we address in this paper by introducing a novel Graph Neural Network (GNN) architecture capable of learning both node and edge features, in contrast to conventional GNNs that focus solely on node features. The key benefit of employing GNNs for link prediction is their ability to connect characters that are spatially distant and oriented in arbitrary directions. We demonstrate our approach on the widely used SynthText dataset, where it delivers superior performance compared to existing state-of-the-art methods.

Time series classification models are gaining prominence, yet research on generating adversarial samples for these models is limited, posing potential security risks. We propose using an adversarial transformation network (ATN) on a distilled model to attack various time series classification models. The attack employs a surrogate distilled model that simulates the behavior of targeted classical time series classifiers. Our methodology is applied to 1-Nearest Neighbor Dynamic Time Warping (1-NN DTW), a Fully Connected Network, and a Fully Convolutional Network (FCN), trained on 42 University of California Riverside (UCR) datasets. We demonstrate that these models are vulnerable to attacks across all datasets. To our knowledge, such an attack on time series classifiers is unprecedented. We recommend future researchers incorporate adversarial samples into training datasets to enhance model resilience and consider robustness as a key evaluative metric.

We address the challenge of estimating the remaining useful life (RUL) of systems or machines using sensor data. Many existing RUL estimation methods rely on assumptions regarding machine degradation patterns, yet sensor data are often noisy and frequently contain missing values in real-world applications. To overcome these limitations, we propose Embed-RUL, a novel approach that does not depend on any degradation-trend assumptions, is robust to noise, and effectively manages missing data. Embed-RUL employs a sequence-to-sequence model based on Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) to generate embeddings for multivariate time series subsequences. These embeddings distinguish between normal and degraded machine states, making them valuable for RUL estimation. We demonstrate that the embeddings capture the overall temporal patterns while filtering out noise, ensuring that machines exhibiting similar operational behavior have embeddings that are closely aligned despite substantial and varying noise levels in their sensor readings. Our experiments on a publicly available turbofan engine dataset and a proprietary real-world dataset show that Embed-RUL outperforms previously reported state-of-the-art methods across multiple evaluation metrics.

To further enhance the training process, it's essential to consider the choice of learning rate in the stochastic gradient descent (SGD) algorithm, as it significantly impacts convergence speed and model performance. A learning rate that's too high can lead to divergence, while a too-low rate may cause the training process to be excessively slow. Adaptive learning rate techniques, such as AdaGrad, RMSprop, or Adam, offer potential solutions by adjusting the learning rate dynamically based on the iterations and gradients observed. Additionally, regularization techniques can be expanded beyond L1 and L2 regularization to include dropout, which randomly deactivates certain neurons during training to prevent co-adaptation and reduce overfitting. Batch normalization can also be applied to stabilize learning by normalizing the input layer by re-centering and re-scaling, thus improving the training speed and performance. Early stopping is another effective method to prevent overfitting, where the training process is halted once the performance on a validation set ceases to improve. Furthermore, data augmentation can be leveraged to artificially expand the training dataset by applying random transformations such as rotation, scaling, or flipping, helping the model generalize better to unseen data. These strategies collectively contribute to robust model training, ensuring that the model not only fits the training data well but also performs effectively on new, unseen inputs.

Single image 3D photography allows viewers to experience a still image from new perspectives. Recent methods have integrated monocular depth networks with inpainting networks to produce impressive outcomes. However, a limitation of these methods is their reliance on hard depth layering, which fails to capture detailed appearance features like thin, hair-like structures. We introduce SLIDE, a modular and cohesive system for single image 3D photography that employs a straightforward yet powerful soft layering strategy to enhance the preservation of appearance details in new views. Moreover, we propose a new depth-aware training approach for our inpainting module, specifically tailored for the 3D photography task. The SLIDE method is modular, allowing integration with other components such as segmentation and matting to improve layering. Additionally, SLIDE utilizes an efficient layered depth formulation that requires only a single forward pass through the component networks to generate high-quality 3D photos. Comprehensive experimental analysis on three view-synthesis datasets, along with user studies on diverse image collections, shows our technique's superior performance compared to existing robust baselines, while maintaining a much simpler conceptual framework. IMAP sẽ tiến hành tính toán ma trận hiệp phương sai giữa các đặc trưng đầu vào, sau đó thực hiện phân rã giá trị riêng để xác định các thành phần chính, từ đó giảm chiều dữ liệu và ánh xạ mỗi điểm ảnh về không gian biểu diễn có số chiều thấp hơn. Các điểm ảnh sau khi được chiếu xuống không gian này sẽ được gán nhãn tương ứng với nguồn gốc (GAN hoặc thật), sau đó biểu diễn trực quan trên mặt phẳng hai chiều hoặc ba chiều nhằm kiểm tra trực quan khả năng tách biệt giữa hai tập dữ liệu. Nếu phân cụm điểm biểu diễn của hai tập có sự tách biệt rõ ràng, điều này cho thấy các đặc trưng trích xuất có khả năng phân biệt ảnh GAN và ảnh thật, đồng thời xác nhận hiệu quả của phương pháp giảm chiều bằng IMAP trong bài toán kiểm tra sự khác biệt giữa các loại ảnh. Nhãn hình Hình 4.2 minh họa rõ ràng toàn bộ luồng xử lý từ khâu thu thập dữ liệu, trích xuất đặc trưng, giảm chiều cho tới biểu diễn không gian điểm, giúp trực quan hóa kết quả và hỗ trợ đánh giá hiệu quả phương pháp.

Trầm cảm ở sinh viên y khoa là một vấn đề quan trọng nhưng hiện vẫn còn ít nghiên cứu đánh giá tại Việt Nam. Mục tiêu của nghiên cứu này là xác định tỷ lệ sinh viên y đa khoa chính quy có dấu hiệu trầm cảm và các yếu tố liên quan. Nghiên cứu cắt ngang được tiến hành trên 358 sinh viên y đa khoa chính quy từ năm thứ nhất đến năm thứ sáu, được chọn ngẫu nhiên tại Trường Đại học Y khoa Phạm Ngọc Thạch. Công cụ sử dụng là thang đo CESD-20 (chuẩn hóa tại Việt Nam với hệ số tin cậy Cronbach’s Alpha là 0,87), với điểm cắt CESD-20 là 22 để xác định dấu hiệu trầm cảm, cùng bộ câu hỏi khảo sát các yếu tố liên quan. Mối liên hệ giữa các yếu tố và dấu hiệu trầm cảm được xác định bằng mô hình hồi quy logistic. Kết quả cho thấy 49,2% sinh viên y đa khoa chính quy có dấu hiệu trầm cảm. Các yếu tố liên quan trong mô hình hồi quy đa biến bao gồm: giới tính, chấm dứt tình bạn, bất đồng hoặc gặp khó khăn với ba mẹ, thay đổi thói quen ăn uống, bỏ bữa, học lực, áp lực học tập cá nhân, và mục tiêu học tập. Số liệu chỉ ra rằng phần lớn sinh viên y đa khoa chính quy gặp nhiều vấn đề liên quan đến trầm cảm trong quá trình học. Việc quan tâm đúng mức đến sức khỏe tâm thần của sinh viên, đồng thời triển khai các biện pháp hỗ trợ từ gia đình và nhà trường, là cần thiết.

Bounding box regression is a crucial component in object detection. Recent studies have demonstrated promising performance by optimizing the Intersection over Union (IoU) as a loss function. However, IoU-based loss suffers from the gradient vanishing problem when bounding boxes have low overlap, causing the model to potentially overlook these simpler cases. In this paper, we propose the Side Overlap (SO) loss, which maximizes the side overlap between two bounding boxes and imposes a greater penalty on cases with low overlap. Additionally, to accelerate convergence, we incorporate the Corner Distance (CD) into the objective function. By combining Side Overlap and Corner Distance, we introduce a new regression objective, the Side and Corner Align Loss (SCALoss). SCALoss maintains a strong correlation with IoU loss, thereby supporting the evaluation metric, while also penalizing low-overlapping cases more effectively. It serves as a comprehensive similarity measure, resulting in improved localization performance and faster convergence. Experiments on the COCO and PASCAL VOC benchmarks demonstrate that SCALoss consistently delivers better results and outperforms \ell_n loss and IoU-based loss when applied to popular object detectors such as YOLOV3, SSD, Reppoints, and Faster-RCNN.

We advance the task of composed image retrieval, where a query is formed by combining an image with a brief textual instruction describing the desired modification. Prior approaches have been largely restricted to simple images from limited domains, like fashion items, thereby constraining the exploration of advanced visual reasoning in diverse and complex image-language contexts. To overcome this limitation, we introduce the Compose Image Retrieval on Real-life images (CIRR) dataset, comprising more than 36,000 pairs of crowd-sourced, open-domain images alongside human-authored modification descriptions. To adapt existing techniques for broader domains, we present CIRPLANT, a transformer-based model that utilizes extensive pre-trained vision-and-language (V&L) representations to adjust visual features according to natural language cues. Retrieval is accomplished through nearest neighbor search in the modified feature space. Our results show that, despite its straightforward design, CIRPLANT surpasses previous methods on open-domain image retrieval and achieves state-of-the-art performance on established specialized datasets, such as those in the fashion domain. With the introduction of CIRR, we anticipate this work will spark further advancements in composed image retrieval research.

Nhiều yếu tố nguy cơ tử vong đã được nghiên cứu, bao gồm điểm Child - Turcotte - Pugh và MELD. Tuy nhiên, các yếu tố nguy cơ tử vong tại Việt Nam chưa được nghiên cứu đầy đủ. Kết cục chính: tử vong trong vòng 3 ngày và 7 ngày. Biến độc lập: Tuổi > 60, xơ gan do rượu và viêm gan vi rút, sốc, mạch nhanh, rối loạn tri giác, báng bụng, INR, hemoglobin, tiểu cầu, creatinin, natri, bilirubin toàn phần, số lần XHTH trên do TALTMC, can thiệp cầm máu qua nội soi, số mililitre máu truyền, Child - Turcotte - Pugh, MELD - Na. In the context of domain-oriented machine translation between English and Vietnamese, mBART (Multilingual Denoising Pre-training for Neural Machine Translation) serves as a foundational model that enhances translation quality by leveraging large-scale monolingual corpora across multiple languages. Unlike earlier models that pretrain only the encoder or decoder, mBART pretrains the entire sequence-to-sequence model using a denoising objective inspired by BART, which involves reconstructing full texts corrupted by noise. This approach employs a standard Transformer architecture with 12 layers in both encoder and decoder, each with a model dimension of 1024 and 16 attention heads, totaling approximately 680 million parameters. To improve stability during training, especially at half-precision floating-point (FP16), mBART incorporates an additional layer-normalization layer atop both encoder and decoder. The denoising process utilizes two types of noise: primarily masking about 35% of words in the input text with mask tokens, where the masked spans follow a Poisson distribution to vary length dynamically, and secondly, the decoder input is offset by one position, receiving the original text shifted by one token. This strategic noise injection compels the model to learn robust contextual representations, which is particularly beneficial in domain-oriented translation tasks where capturing nuanced linguistic phenomena and domain-specific terminology is essential. By pretraining on diverse multilingual data and employing sophisticated noise modeling, mBART provides a strong backbone for fine-tuning on English-Vietnamese domain-specific datasets, ultimately leading to improved translation accuracy and fluency in specialized fields such as medicine, law, or technology.

In the realm of natural language processing (NLP), the work by M. Honnibal and I. Montani on "Spacy 2" stands as a pivotal contribution, particularly in the integration of advanced techniques such as bloom embeddings, convolutional neural networks (CNNs), and incremental parsing. These components are essential for enhancing the accuracy and efficiency of language models. Bloom embeddings, for instance, significantly reduce memory footprint while maintaining high performance, making them ideal for large-scale applications. CNNs contribute by providing robust feature extraction capabilities, crucial for capturing complex linguistic patterns. Incremental parsing, on the other hand, facilitates real-time processing, an advantage for applications requiring immediate language understanding, such as conversational agents and real-time translation services. As detailed in the Proceedings of the 18th Conference on Computational Natural Language Learning (CoNLL) 2014, pages 573–578, these elements collectively elevate Spacy 2's capability to handle diverse NLP tasks with enhanced precision and speed. This holistic approach not only optimizes computational resources but also opens avenues for further innovations in the field, encouraging the exploration of hybrid models that integrate multiple methodologies for superior language comprehension.

The application is initially deployed using the Google Kubernetes Engine by creating a new cluster. This cluster operates with autoscaling enabled, where GKE’s cluster autoscaler dynamically adjusts the number of nodes in a specified node pool according to the workload demands. When demand decreases, the autoscaler reduces the cluster size to a minimum level set by the user. This functionality enhances workload availability during peak times while managing costs effectively, eliminating the need for manual node addition, removal, or over-provisioning of node pools.

Restricted Boltzmann Machines (RBMs) are widely used unsupervised learning models for capturing generative representations of data distributions. Typically, RBMs are trained using the Contrastive Divergence (CD) algorithm, which provides an approximation to the true gradient of the data log-likelihood. While reconstruction error is commonly employed to assess the adequacy of this approximation, several studies (Schulz et al., 2010; Fischer & Igel, 2010) have questioned the reliability of this metric. Despite these concerns, few alternative evaluation methods have been explored in the literature. In this manuscript, we investigate simple alternatives to reconstruction error for more effectively and promptly detecting decreases in log-likelihood during RBM training.

This study contributes to the field of few-shot learning by demonstrating a method that leverages pre-trained classifiers from large-scale datasets across different domains, adapting them to new tasks with limited base class data. By employing a two-stage representation adaptation process and utilizing spatial attention maps, our approach addresses the challenge of focusing on relevant objects rather than background noise. This is particularly significant for scenarios where base class data are scarce, offering a practical alternative to learning from scratch or relying on meta-learning techniques. The findings highlight the potential applications of this method in real-world situations where access to comprehensive datasets is restricted, paving the way for further research and development in deploying AI systems that require minimal data to operate effectively across diverse domains.

Effective inventory rotation and management within logistics warehouses are critical components for operational efficiency and cost reduction. The systematic organization and arrangement of goods not only conserve storage space but also enhance managerial oversight, facilitating smoother inventory turnover and minimizing overall operational expenses. Despite these clear benefits, many companies have yet to prioritize or implement optimized storage placement strategies, often resulting in underutilized space and increased handling times. The complexity of warehouse management is further compounded by the diversity of goods stored, which vary significantly in size, type, and required storage conditions, including temperature control and shelf life considerations. Consequently, categorizing goods based on these parameters—such as size and expiration date—is essential for maintaining the integrity and safety of stored items. The establishment of a warehouse island process becomes particularly pertinent when managing large volumes and varieties of inventory, as it enables more targeted and efficient storage solutions. Crucially, the use of advanced technologies, such as RFID (Radio Frequency Identification), supports real-time and precise tracking of product locations, thereby facilitating continuous monitoring and timely adjustments in inventory placement. This technological integration reduces risks associated with misplacement, spoilage, and loss, while streamlining the movement and retrieval of goods within the warehouse. Ultimately, by implementing a structured system that incorporates both strategic sorting and technological monitoring, logistics operations can significantly improve their inventory rotation practices, enhance safety, and achieve greater overall efficiency in warehouse management.

Deep reinforcement learning predominantly emphasizes behavioral learning, frequently neglecting the substantial influence of an agent’s morphology on its functional capabilities. The question thus arises: what methodology should be employed to identify morphologies suited to task resolution within a specified environment? Prevailing strategies that co-adapt morphology and behavior utilize the reward signal from a particular task to guide morphology optimization; however, these methods typically entail costly policy optimization procedures and yield morphologies that are inherently task-dependent and lack generalizability. In this study, we introduce Task-Agnostic Morphology Evolution (TAME), a novel method designed to address these limitations. TAME evolves agent morphologies in the absence of any explicit task or reward specification, relying solely on the application of randomly sampled action primitives to a population of agents. This process is guided by an information-theoretic objective that efficiently ranks agents according to their capacity to reach a diverse array of environmental states and the causal impact of their actions. Our empirical results demonstrate that, across 2D, 3D, and manipulation tasks, TAME is capable of evolving morphologies that achieve multi-task performance on par with those developed through task-supervised algorithms. Our code and videos are available at https://sites.google.com/view/task-agnostic-evolution.

The issue: Mental health concerns are receiving increasing societal attention. Medical school lecturers (GV) play a crucial role by both teaching and training at medical universities and participating in clinical practice at healthcare facilities. The high workload and pressure may adversely affect the mental health of lecturers. Currently, research on the mental health of medical school lecturers in Vietnam is limited, including at Pham Ngoc Thach University of Medicine (ĐHYKPNT). Therefore, this study aims to determine the prevalence of stress, anxiety, depression, and associated factors among lecturers at ĐHYKPNT in order to propose solutions to improve lecturers' mental health, thereby enhancing their work performance and quality of life. Objective: To determine the prevalence of lecturers exhibiting signs of stress, anxiety, depression, and related factors at ĐHYKPNT. Subjects and Methods: A cross-sectional study was conducted on 369 lecturers from December 2023 to January 2024. Participants were selected using a multistage sampling method. Data were collected via self-administered questionnaires. Signs of stress, anxiety, and depression were assessed by the DASS-21 scale. Results: The proportions of lecturers exhibiting signs of stress, anxiety, and depression were 28.18%, 32.52%, and 25.47%, respectively. Multivariate analysis identified factors associated with stress as financial status, sleep habits, bedtime, sleep onset latency, excessive alcohol consumption, use of mental health care services, and work-related pressure from the university; factors associated with anxiety as training expertise, termination of friendships, barriers to social activities, acute illness or cancer diagnosis, eating habits, pressure from university-related work, and pressure from external part-time work; factors associated with depression as conflicts with family/parents/spouse/partner, bedtime, sleep onset latency, pressure from university-related work, and job satisfaction. Conclusion: The relatively high prevalence of stress, anxiety, and depression among lecturers provides evidence to inform the university's policies, strategies, and interventions for the prevention of stress, anxiety, and depression among lecturers at ĐHYKPNT.

We present a formal, straightforward, and intuitive framework for rational decision making, encompassing sequential decisions that influence the environment. The framework possesses a geometric perspective, which facilitates visualization and comprehension of the arguments. Our approach addresses complete decision makers, defined as those with a comprehensive set of preferences. The principal finding demonstrates that a complete rational decision maker inherently possesses a probabilistic representation of the environment. We introduce a countable formulation of this finding, elucidating the distinction between countable and finite additivity by revealing its dependence on the geometry of the preference space. This insight is achieved by effectively linking rationality with the Hahn-Banach Theorem. The framework proposed here can be regarded as a formalization and advancement of the betting odds approach to probability initially developed by Ramsey and De Finetti.

Controller trong mô hình MVC đóng vai trò trung gian quan trọng, giúp quản lý luồng thông tin giữa view và model. Khi một request từ người dùng được gửi đến thông qua biểu mẫu HTTP, nhiệm vụ đầu tiên của controller là nhận diện và xử lý request đó. Thông thường, controller sẽ phân tích request để xác định hành động cụ thể cần thực hiện, từ đó xác định model nào sẽ được sử dụng để lấy hoặc cập nhật dữ liệu. Model là lớp chịu trách nhiệm tương tác trực tiếp với cơ sở dữ liệu, đảm bảo rằng dữ liệu được truy xuất hoặc lưu trữ một cách chính xác và hiệu quả. Sau khi controller nhận được dữ liệu từ model, bước tiếp theo của quá trình là chuẩn bị dữ liệu để đưa vào view. View là lớp chịu trách nhiệm hiển thị thông tin cho người dùng, đảm bảo rằng dữ liệu được trình bày một cách rõ ràng và dễ hiểu. Controller sẽ chuyển dữ liệu đã xử lý đến view, nơi mà dữ liệu này sẽ được kết hợp với các yếu tố giao diện người dùng (UI) để tạo thành response hoàn chỉnh. Sự kết hợp này bao gồm việc tái cấu trúc và định dạng dữ liệu để phù hợp với nhu cầu hiển thị, chẳng hạn như chuyển đổi dữ liệu thô thành bảng biểu hoặc danh sách có định dạng đẹp mắt. Quá trình này không chỉ đảm bảo rằng người dùng nhận được thông tin một cách nhanh chóng và chính xác mà còn tạo điều kiện cho việc duy trì và mở rộng ứng dụng dễ dàng hơn. Một trong những ưu điểm nổi bật của mô hình MVC là khả năng tách biệt rõ ràng các thành phần logic của ứng dụng. Điều này không chỉ giúp tăng cường khả năng bảo trì mã nguồn mà còn cho phép các nhà phát triển làm việc song song trên các phần khác nhau của ứng dụng mà không gây xung đột. Ví dụ, một nhà phát triển có thể cải tiến giao diện người dùng trong view mà không ảnh hưởng đến logic dữ liệu trong model. We present a novel virtual environment designed for simulating the card game "Big 2," a four-player game characterized by imperfect information and a complex action space, allowing combinations of 1 to 5 cards from a hand of 13. To address this, we employ the recently introduced "Proximal Policy Optimization" algorithm to train a deep neural network solely through self-play. Our findings indicate that the trained model achieves a performance level surpassing that of amateur human players after a relatively brief training period, without the necessity of exploring future game state trees.

This paper focuses on identifying a parameter-varying linear model—specifically, a grey-box model—for the superheated steam temperature of a boiler, based on the time-varying steam flow parameter, using a local identification method. Instead of constructing a model solely from physical laws or independently from experimental data, a combination of analytical and experimental approaches is utilized to determine the LPV model for the superheated steam temperature of the boiler. The parameters of the superheated steam temperature model are approximated as a function proportional to the superheated steam flow. The global LPV model is estimated by applying a parameter interpolation technique to the parameters of the local linear models. The proposed method is applied to the identification of the superheated steam temperature at Pha Lai Power Plant. The results demonstrate that the obtained superheated steam temperature model exhibits high accuracy and the proposed method is feasible.

In this paper, we revisit the classical representation of 3D point clouds using linear shape models. Our main contribution is the integration of deep learning to represent a collection of shapes as affine transformations of low-dimensional linear shape models. Each linear model is defined by a shape prototype, a low-dimensional shape basis, and two neural networks. These networks take a point cloud as input and predict both the coordinates of the shape in the linear basis and the affine transformation that best approximates the input. Both the linear models and neural networks are trained end-to-end using a single reconstruction loss. Unlike many recent deep learning approaches that rely on complex, feature-based shape representations, our method is explicit, with all operations occurring directly in 3D space. Consequently, our linear shape models are easily visualized, annotated, and interpreted, enabling a clear understanding of failure cases. While our primary objective is to introduce a compact and interpretable representation for shape collections, we demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art results in few-shot segmentation.

The FL process advances through a sequence of iterative model updates, as depicted in Figure 3.1. At the outset, the server initializes the model parameters, either randomly or by loading them from a previously saved checkpoint. The server then distributes the global model parameters to all connected client nodes, establishing a consistent starting point for local training among the participants. Each client node proceeds to train the model locally on its own dataset, but this training is limited to a single epoch or a few mini-batches rather than reaching full convergence. After completing this local training phase, each client has a slightly altered set of model parameters reflecting the distinct characteristics of its local data. These updated parameters are sent back to the server, which aggregates them to update the global model parameters. This cycle is repeated, with each round further refining the global model, until the model is fully trained.

Label Propagation (LPA) and Graph Convolutional Neural Networks (GCN) are both message-passing algorithms applied to graphs, designed to solve the task of node classification. While LPA propagates node label information across graph edges, GCN propagates and transforms node feature information. Despite their conceptual similarity, the theoretical relationship between LPA and GCN has not yet been thoroughly investigated. In this study, we examine the relationship between LPA and GCN from two perspectives: (1) feature/label smoothing, where we analyze how the feature or label of a node disseminates across its neighbors; and (2) feature/label influence, which quantifies how much the initial feature or label of one node affects the final feature or label of another node. Building on this theoretical analysis, we propose an end-to-end model that unifies GCN and LPA for node classification. In our unified framework, edge weights are learnable, with LPA serving as a regularization mechanism that guides the GCN in learning appropriate edge weights, thereby enhancing classification performance. Additionally, our model can be interpreted as learning attention weights informed by node labels, offering a more task-oriented approach compared to existing feature-based attention models. Extensive experiments on real-world graphs demonstrate that our model outperforms state-of-the-art GCN-based methods in node classification accuracy.

The Oulu-CASIA dataset is a widely recognized benchmark in the field of facial expression analysis, providing a diverse set of images that capture a range of emotions across different lighting conditions and subjects. By leveraging this dataset, we ensure that our evaluations are comprehensive and reflect real-world scenarios. The experimental setup involved training the TER-GAN model with a subset of the dataset and testing its performance on unseen samples to assess its generalization capabilities. We used standard metrics such as accuracy, F1-score, and mean squared error to quantitatively measure the performance of our model across the three tasks: FET, FEE, and FER. Additionally, qualitative assessments were conducted by visualizing the output images to ensure that the generated expressions were both realistic and identity-preserving. Our results indicate that TER-GAN not only surpasses traditional methods in terms of accuracy but also demonstrates robustness across varying conditions, as evidenced by its stable performance across different expression intensities and identities. Furthermore, an ablation study was performed to evaluate the contribution of each component of the TER-GAN architecture, highlighting the importance of the expression and identity consistency losses in enhancing feature disentanglement. Overall, the TER-GAN framework presents a significant advancement in the field of facial expression analysis, offering a versatile tool for applications in animation, human-computer interaction, and psychological studies. Future work will explore scaling the model to accommodate larger datasets and extending its application to dynamic video sequences, thereby further broadening its utility and impact.

The proliferation of highly realistic counterfeit images generated via Deepfake or GANs poses significant societal disruptions. Numerous techniques have been introduced to detect such fake images; however, these approaches are susceptible to adversarial perturbations—deliberately crafted noise capable of inducing incorrect predictions. Conventional attack methods on fake image detectors typically generate perturbations across nearly the entire image, resulting in redundancy and heightened perceptibility. This paper introduces a novel approach to undermine fake image detection by identifying key pixels relevant to a fake image detector and selectively attacking only these pixels, thereby significantly reducing the L_0 and L_2 norms of adversarial perturbations compared to existing methods. Experimental results on two public datasets using three fake image detectors demonstrate that the proposed method attains state-of-the-art performance in both white-box and black-box attack scenarios.

The widespread adoption of deep learning models necessitates their robustness. In this paper, we explore the robustness of deep neural networks applied to videos, which involve both the spatial features of individual frames extracted by a convolutional neural network and the temporal dynamics between adjacent frames captured by a recurrent neural network. To gauge robustness, we investigate the maximum safe radius problem, which calculates the minimum distance from the optical flow sequence of a given input to that of an adversarial example in the input's vicinity. We demonstrate that, assuming Lipschitz continuity, this problem can be approximated using finite optimization by discretizing the optical flow space, with the approximation providing provable guarantees. Subsequently, we reveal that the finite optimization problem can be resolved through a two-player turn-based game in a cooperative context, where the first player selects the optical flows, and the second player identifies the dimensions to be manipulated within the chosen flow. We adopt an anytime approach to solve the game, incrementally approximating the game's value by improving its upper and lower bounds. We employ a gradient-based search algorithm to determine the upper bounds and the admissible A* algorithm to refine the lower bounds. Finally, we assess our framework using the UCF101 video dataset.

FIFO algorithm (First In, First Out): According to this algorithm, goods are arranged in the order they arrive, and are taken out and distributed in the order they arrived. This ensures that goods are distributed in a timely manner and minimizes the risk of expired products staying in the warehouse for too long. In the context of RFID automated inventory systems in logistics warehouses, the FIFO algorithm can be significantly enhanced by real-time tracking and data collection capabilities provided by RFID tags and readers. RFID technology enables precise monitoring of the entry time and location of each item, allowing the system to automatically prioritize and manage stock based on arrival dates without manual intervention. This automation reduces human error in inventory rotation, improves accuracy in stock management, and increases operational efficiency. Furthermore, integrating FIFO with RFID systems facilitates proactive alerts for approaching expiration dates or long-stored goods, enabling warehouse managers to make informed decisions on redistribution or discounting strategies. As a result, implementing FIFO through RFID automation not only supports effective inventory rotation but also contributes to reducing waste, optimizing storage space, and enhancing overall supply chain responsiveness in logistics warehouses.

Hệ thống cũng gợi ý những đề thi cùng chủ đề, cùng loại với đề thi người dùng vừa hoàn thành.
